warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points from a magical botch.
warping.notes: Avoid: stress die + Sta + Concentration + Travel bonus vs stress die + Warping Score + Warping Points gained + aura. If not: every summoned spirit goes free and his rituals end. Duration by a secret simple die (+/-3 a Confidence Point, +/- the Travel bonus): 1 or less Diameter (+3 Corruption), 2-4 Sun (+2), 5-7 Moon (+1), 8-9 Season (+1 Spirit), 10+ Year (+3 Spirit); he gains Warping Points equal to the modified roll, and each rise in Warping Score banks a Corruption Point. The storyguide spends Spirit Points on xp, naranjs, vis or Confidence, and Corruption Points on aging, wounds, bad Reputation or Flaws. A typical sahir gains 2 Warping Points a year.

entries.notes: Built as sahirs otherwise. Usually also Fida'i (Martial Abilities at creation) or Lasiq (commands up to six fida'is); Trained Assassin gives 50 xp to Martial Abilities, Athletics, Guile and Stealth. A mustajib who has initiated 2 or more arts besides Sihr is a da'i; every Gifted mustajib is one. UnGifted should take Necessary Condition and Prohibition. Initiations take place at Alamut (Magic aura 3).

initiation.notes: The book prints no Initiation Total for these scripts; this uses the usual mystagogue's total + Script Bonus against the EF.

scripts.name: Solomonic Sihr and the rank of Mustajib
scripts.ordeal: Necessary Condition (brandishing a weapon) on all magic; Prohibition: betraying the sect
scripts.notes: Ramadan +3, quest for a companion spirit +3, Necessary Condition +9, Prohibition +3. The Gifted rite is similar but gives no Flaws.

scripts.name: Solomonic Storytelling
scripts.notes: Renounce possessions, family and name +2; at Sirius's rising +3; a quest over three insulae for three emotion-objects +6; a season composing an encoded poem +1; Disorientating Magic +3.

entries.name: Soban Alchemists
entries.description: The alchemists of Soba in Nubia, who each brew a Sovereign Reagent of their own and spend a dose to give or take one property of lifeless matter. They serve the city's Ministry.
entries.notes: The Gifted can learn Soban Alchemy from books; the unGifted need the Virtue or the Ministry's initiation. Alchemist of Soba (Minor Status) owes two or more seasons a year to the Ministry (Exposure xp only) unless Wealthy or protected. Duration: the score sets the unit (1 minutes, 3 hours, 5 days, 7 weeks, 9 months) and a simple die the number of units. A dose covers 1 cubic foot of solid, 1 cubic pace of fluid or 10 of something ephemeral. Changed matter is a magical medium and gains a Warping Point a year.

training.notes: Alchemist of Soba requires Philosophiae 3 or more.

casting.name: Soban Alchemy
casting.vis: each casting spends a dose of Sovereign Reagent (1 Mythic Pound or 1 pawn of Muto)
casting.notes: EF 9 colour, taste, texture, symmetry; 12 smell, floating, sharpness, elasticity, flexibility, moistness; 15 transparency, solidity, hardness, brittleness, heat or cold, resonance, silence; 18 rising or falling, luminosity. One property, wholly given or taken. Penetration = total - EF + Penetration bonus.

advancement.notes: Making reagent gives Exposure only, in Soban Alchemy, Philosophiae or Apothecary.

activities.label: Make Sovereign Reagent
activities.summary: A season: up to 2 x Profession: Apothecary doses, each costing a Mythic Pound or a Muto pawn.

pools.name: Sovereign Reagent
pools.income: Up to 2 x Profession: Apothecary doses a season of making.
pools.notes: Each alchemist's recipe is his own.

entries.name: Cult of Dedun
entries.description: A Nubian Mystery Cult of undying sorcerers who gather courts of royal corpses, rising from Adherent to Altar Priest, Temple Priest and at last Undying One.
entries.notes: Members often also have Learned Magic, Goetic Summoning or Commanding, or curses. Breaking the Adherent's Prohibition brings Dedun's Shadow, resolved like an aging Crisis and adding Lame, Palsied or Afflicted Tongue. Rank needs: Altar Priest Org Lore 1 and Meroitic 3; Temple Priest Org Lore 3 and Meroitic 4; Undying One Org Lore 5, Warping + Decrepitude 7+, Gifted, a past Temple Priest with Enfeebled, and only at Meroe.

casting.name: Dedun's Blessing
casting.notes: After a ceremony each season for a year: EF 9 + the aura, +1 a year of trying. Several priests may pool their bonuses. Needs Dedun's Blessing.

casting.name: Corpse Magic
casting.notes: Lands of the Nile p. 102: fifteen minutes' chanting over a corpse with no Divine burial (spine, skull and over half the long bones). EF 9 speak, 12 compel truth or protect the corpse, 15 animate within sight, 18 animate under mental control. Commands: Com + Leadership + stress die against 6, 9 or 12, Leadership capped by the corpse's language below 5; three failures lay it to rest until moonrise. The Penetration Total must exceed its Might (usually 9) for it to leave the grave. Needs the Corpse Magic Virtue.

initiation.notes: +3 (Minor) or +9 (Major) to the EF when the Virtue is unknown to the initiate. Only Gifted members may initiate themselves.

scripts.name: Altar Priest
scripts.notes: A season of seclusion +3 (counts as Teaching), incense +1, the Vow +3.

scripts.name: Temple Priest
scripts.gains: Unnatural Vitality (Major) and a Court; -3 Living Conditions
scripts.notes: Quest for a never-exhumed corpse of Reputation 5+ +6, Enfeebled +9.

scripts.name: Undying One
scripts.notes: EF -9 for the earlier Ordeal and +9 for self-initiation. Quest +1, a year of chanting +4, incense +1, vis each new moon +1, losing The Gift +9.

activities.label: Align an aura to the dead
activities.summary: A ceremony each season for a year, then Dedun's Blessing roll: the Magic aura counts double for work with the dead.

bonds.name: Court
bonds.how: Gathering corpses (Temple Priest and above).
bonds.feeds: Court strength, the sum of each corpse's highest Reputation in life (at least 1; a king 7, a sub-king 5; -3 for a Divine burial).
bonds.notes: Each corpse is a permanent Arcane Connection, with sympathy through its name. An Undying One buys his Might with the strength as xp, and his Court is an aura of strength / 10 (round up) against Acclimation.

entries.name: Lector Priests
entries.description: Egypt's ritual readers, faerie rite wizards who read one-effect scrolls in a state of purity within a Faerie aura, and make amulets and seals that last only for a time.
entries.notes: With Realms of Power: Faerie they are Faerie rite wizards (Evocation, Grant, Weal, Ware, Woe and Ceremony) and convert texts as that book says. Without it, use the scroll rite here; the book doesn't say which Arts a lector priest has. Followers join a Ceremony on Com + Leadership vs 3 + 1 a follower. Temporary amulets (Until duration), seals, potions made through cippus statues and models brought to life are faerie bargains. Spells carried by breath or spittle count as Personal but don't bypass Magic Resistance.

casting.name: Scroll rite
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level on success; 2 at 1-10 short; 3 at 11-20 short; 4 and a Warping Point at 21-30 short
casting.notes: Sta + the nearest Technique + the nearest Form + aura. Needs ritual purity and a Faerie aura; each scroll holds one effect at fixed Range, Duration and Target. 31 or more short: not cast, 5 Fatigue levels, Warping Points equal to the magnitude, and a Twilight-like episode if more than 2.

casting.name: Read the scroll
casting.notes: EF 3 + 1 per 5 levels of the spell; symbolic texts raise it. A botch misfires or brings faerie persecution.

activities.label: Make a transitory item or statue
activities.summary: A temporary amulet, a seal or a potion poured over a statue, each holding one Until effect for one use; or a faerie persuaded into a statue (Lands of the Nile pp. 51-54). The book sets no total for them; a new statue's consecration is Com + Folk Ken + a die against 18.

entries.name: Settuten (Berber)
entries.description: The Berber settuten, witches of the moon god Ayyur, whose amulets dissolve and undo: matter, bonds between people, distance, a spirit's hold on a place, and The Gift itself. Almost all are women.
entries.notes: Each power is a Major Supernatural Virtue granting it at 0, and an Accelerated Ability. A man must take Transvestite (here Gender Nonconforming). Settut Divination makes her a seeress: never Favored, it is needed to lead, Open The Gift or help initiate. Learning a Favored Ability, a Gifted settut doesn't lose her Favored total from Source Quality. Usual Abilities: Penetration, Finesse, Organization Lore: Settuten, Chirurgy, a Profession; Herbalism for folk medicine. Duration modifiers to the EF: Lunar Day +0, Moon +3, Lunar Year +6, Nineteen Years +9. An amulet can be dispelled before use only at twice its equivalent level (its Potency). Design & Inscription bonuses are capped by Craft: Iharzen. Settuten have no passive Magical Defenses: the jedwel dispels stand in for them. Useless vis: any other kind. Hermetic Virtues and Flaws may shape her powers (Cyclic Magic by moon or sun is common). Gifted Berber settuten take Disjunction on themselves at a convocation to hide The Gift; Gifted boys are usually 'cured' by a Lunar Year Disjunction.

training.notes: About ten years from age 7 to 12, 200 xp on the tradition's Supernatural Abilities and General and Arcane Abilities; no Academic or Martial Abilities without a Virtue that allows them. Craft: Iharzen is required. After, 15 xp a year. UnGifted members buy each power as its Virtue; more come only by initiation.

casting.name: Lesser amulet
casting.vis: Perdo or Vim for any power; Mentem for Dissidence and Dismay; Rego for Dismissal and Dislocation; Aquam, Auram, Ignem or Terram for Dissolution; Intellego for Magic Sensitivity
casting.notes: Potency = Pre + power + aura where she uses it; the amulet's Casting Total is Potency + a die (simple or stress) against the power's EF + the Duration modifier. Penetration = total - EF + the wielder's Penetration. Made in minutes from sand, clay, flour or salt; always at hand.

casting.name: Greater amulet
casting.notes: This total is the batch's Potency: Int + power + Craft: Iharzen + a Design & Inscription bonus + the aura where it is made. Used later as Potency + a die, as a lesser amulet. Vis per batch: power / 5 (round up) pawns for every 3 amulets or part.

casting.name: Divination (casual)
casting.vis: Perdo or Vim for any power; Mentem for Dissidence and Dismay; Rego for Dismissal and Dislocation; Aquam, Auram, Ignem or Terram for Dissolution; Intellego for Magic Sensitivity
casting.notes: A round; adds an omen bonus of +1 to +3. Penetration = total - level + Penetration.

casting.name: Divination (ceremonial)
casting.vis: Perdo or Vim for any power; Mentem for Dissidence and Dismay; Rego for Dismissal and Dislocation; Aquam, Auram, Ignem or Terram for Dissolution; Intellego for Magic Sensitivity
casting.notes: 15 minutes a magnitude; adds the method's ceremonial bonus and the sum of Arcane or sympathetic connection multipliers.

dispels.name: Jedwel (Disjunction)
dispels.notes: Sta + Disjunction + stress die against the spell's level, the power's EF, or 5 x a creature power's Might cost (at least its Might). First Qik + Finesse + stress die must beat the attacker's Initiative, and an unfamiliar effect must be identified with Per + Magic Sensitivity. No Penetration needed. Works against magic already in place, of any kind, by touch on her own turn with no Speed roll; EF halved for her own effects (Snake, silver or white).

dispels.name: Jedwel (Dismissal)
dispels.notes: Sta + Dismissal + stress die against the spell's level, the power's EF, or 5 x a creature power's Might cost (at least its Might). First Qik + Finesse + stress die must beat the attacker's Initiative, and an unfamiliar effect must be identified with Per + Magic Sensitivity. No Penetration needed. Works against a creature's offensive power, not Personal or continuing ones (Saw, gold or yellow).

dispels.name: Jedwel (Dissidence)
dispels.notes: Sta + Dissidence + stress die against the spell's level, the power's EF, or 5 x a creature power's Might cost (at least its Might). First Qik + Finesse + stress die must beat the attacker's Initiative, and an unfamiliar effect must be identified with Per + Magic Sensitivity. No Penetration needed. Works against spells on her mind or body, or the touched object's substance (Afous, blue); Dismay serves the same.

dispels.name: Jedwel (Dissolution)
dispels.notes: Sta + Dissolution + stress die against the spell's level, the power's EF, or 5 x a creature power's Might cost (at least its Might). First Qik + Finesse + stress die must beat the attacker's Initiative, and an unfamiliar effect must be identified with Per + Magic Sensitivity. No Penetration needed. Works against effects that create a magical medium (Eye, green copper).

opening.notes: A seeress Opens a Gifted apprentice, usually at a convocation, with her Divination; she gains her branch's five Favored Abilities at 0. The book gives no Opening Total: Int + Divination + aura is only a reasonable reading.

advancement.notes: Mostly by Practice. Only Gifted settuten study from vis; the pawn cost and Quality are not given. Hounding sahirs or exorcising spirits gives story xp; grave inscriptions give tractatus, and Tin Hinan's tomb summae (Quality 6-12).

activities.label: Make greater amulets
activities.summary: A season (a long-term Fatigue level): up to 4 batches, one per power, 2 x Craft: Iharzen amulets in all. Each day away past 10 is -2 Potency.

warping.name: Tamzawit Curse
warping.trigger: Each rise in the Warping Score.
warping.notes: No Warping Points from strong Magic auras. She becomes a dust devil (Tuareg: a waral lizard) of Size = Warping Score for at least a lunar month, with no magic, no xp, harmed only by magic. Each month: Sta + Concentration + stress die vs 6 + Warping Score ends it; a botch adds Warping Points equal to its zeros. More months than the new score: lose 2 x the Warping Points gained in xp from a power, or a Minor Flaw; otherwise gain 5 xp a month in a power, or a Minor Virtue.

entries.name: Settuten (Tuareg)
entries.description: The Tuareg settuten, witches of the moon god Ayyur, whose amulets dissolve and undo: matter, bonds between people, distance, a spirit's hold on a place, and The Gift itself. Almost all are women.
entries.notes: Each power is a Major Supernatural Virtue granting it at 0, and an Accelerated Ability. A man must take Transvestite (here Gender Nonconforming). Settut Divination makes her a seeress: never Favored, it is needed to lead, Open The Gift or help initiate. Learning a Favored Ability, a Gifted settut doesn't lose her Favored total from Source Quality. Usual Abilities: Penetration, Finesse, Organization Lore: Settuten, Chirurgy, a Profession; Herbalism for folk medicine. Duration modifiers to the EF: Lunar Day +0, Moon +3, Lunar Year +6, Nineteen Years +9. An amulet can be dispelled before use only at twice its equivalent level (its Potency). Design & Inscription bonuses are capped by Craft: Iharzen. Settuten have no passive Magical Defenses: the jedwel dispels stand in for them. Useless vis: any other kind. Hermetic Virtues and Flaws may shape her powers (Cyclic Magic by moon or sun is common). Tuareg settuten hold no local convocations, are traded between bands, and their Divination is usually the Geomancy variant. Tuareg men who gain Dislocation get no jedwel defenses unless raised as a settut.

training.notes: About ten years from age 7 to 12, 200 xp on the tradition's Supernatural Abilities and General and Arcane Abilities; no Academic or Martial Abilities without a Virtue that allows them. Craft: Iharzen is required. After, 15 xp a year. UnGifted members buy each power as its Virtue; more come only by initiation.

casting.name: Lesser amulet
casting.vis: Perdo or Vim for any power; Mentem for Dissidence and Dismay; Rego for Dismissal and Dislocation; Aquam, Auram, Ignem or Terram for Dissolution; Intellego for Magic Sensitivity
casting.notes: Potency = Pre + power + aura where she uses it; the amulet's Casting Total is Potency + a die (simple or stress) against the power's EF + the Duration modifier. Penetration = total - EF + the wielder's Penetration. Made in minutes from sand, clay, flour or salt; always at hand.

casting.name: Greater amulet
casting.notes: This total is the batch's Potency: Int + power + Craft: Iharzen + a Design & Inscription bonus + the aura where it is made. Used later as Potency + a die, as a lesser amulet. Vis per batch: power / 5 (round up) pawns for every 3 amulets or part.

casting.name: Divination (casual)
casting.vis: Perdo or Vim for any power; Mentem for Dissidence and Dismay; Rego for Dismissal and Dislocation; Aquam, Auram, Ignem or Terram for Dissolution; Intellego for Magic Sensitivity
casting.notes: A round; adds an omen bonus of +1 to +3. Penetration = total - level + Penetration.

casting.name: Divination (ceremonial)
casting.vis: Perdo or Vim for any power; Mentem for Dissidence and Dismay; Rego for Dismissal and Dislocation; Aquam, Auram, Ignem or Terram for Dissolution; Intellego for Magic Sensitivity
casting.notes: 15 minutes a magnitude; adds the method's ceremonial bonus and the sum of Arcane or sympathetic connection multipliers.

dispels.name: Jedwel (Dislocation)
dispels.notes: Sta + Dislocation + stress die against the spell's level, the power's EF, or 5 x a creature power's Might cost (at least its Might). First Qik + Finesse + stress die must beat the attacker's Initiative, and an unfamiliar effect must be identified with Per + Magic Sensitivity. No Penetration needed. Works against any aimed spell (Lion's Paw, onyx or black).

dispels.name: Jedwel (Dismay)
dispels.notes: Sta + Dismay + stress die against the spell's level, the power's EF, or 5 x a creature power's Might cost (at least its Might). First Qik + Finesse + stress die must beat the attacker's Initiative, and an unfamiliar effect must be identified with Per + Magic Sensitivity. No Penetration needed. Works against spells on her mind or body, or the touched object's substance (Afous, blue); Dissidence serves the same.

dispels.name: Jedwel (Dismissal)
dispels.notes: Sta + Dismissal + stress die against the spell's level, the power's EF, or 5 x a creature power's Might cost (at least its Might). First Qik + Finesse + stress die must beat the attacker's Initiative, and an unfamiliar effect must be identified with Per + Magic Sensitivity. No Penetration needed. Works against a creature's offensive power, not Personal or continuing ones (Saw, gold or yellow).

dispels.name: Jedwel (Dissolution)
dispels.notes: Sta + Dissolution + stress die against the spell's level, the power's EF, or 5 x a creature power's Might cost (at least its Might). First Qik + Finesse + stress die must beat the attacker's Initiative, and an unfamiliar effect must be identified with Per + Magic Sensitivity. No Penetration needed. Works against effects that create a magical medium (Eye, green copper).

opening.notes: A seeress Opens a Gifted apprentice, usually at a convocation, with her Divination; she gains her branch's five Favored Abilities at 0. The book gives no Opening Total: Int + Divination + aura is only a reasonable reading.

advancement.notes: Mostly by Practice. Only Gifted settuten study from vis; the pawn cost and Quality are not given. Hounding sahirs or exorcising spirits gives story xp; grave inscriptions give tractatus, and Tin Hinan's tomb summae (Quality 6-12).

activities.label: Make greater amulets
activities.summary: A season (a long-term Fatigue level): up to 4 batches, one per power, 2 x Craft: Iharzen amulets in all. Each day away past 10 is -2 Potency.

warping.name: Tamzawit Curse
warping.trigger: Each rise in the Warping Score.
warping.notes: No Warping Points from strong Magic auras. She becomes a dust devil (Tuareg: a waral lizard) of Size = Warping Score for at least a lunar month, with no magic, no xp, harmed only by magic. Each month: Sta + Concentration + stress die vs 6 + Warping Score ends it; a botch adds Warping Points equal to its zeros. More months than the new score: lose 2 x the Warping Points gained in xp from a power, or a Minor Flaw; otherwise gain 5 xp a month in a power, or a Minor Virtue.

entries.name: Imhergi and Ngagef
entries.description: Berber tattoo magicians: the male imhergi ('sun magicians') and the female ngagef cosmeticians, cunning-folk learned magicians who draw their charms as temporary tattoos or chalk signs, and make lasting tattoos in place of amulets.
entries.notes: Built as Cunning Folk (Hedge Magic RE learned magicians: Mythic Herbalism and Entreat the Faerie Powers), with Slow Caster since they draw rather than speak. A permanent tattoo or inscription (ahadjam) replaces chartae and amulets: it works when uncovered, until its charges or Duration end, then fades. Lab Totals use Craft: Tattoo for Artes Liberales, and may add Design & Inscription bonuses up to Craft: Tattoo. Rare Gifted inenden craftsmen work the same way with leather and metal amulets (Laboratory Magician, No Text Casting).

training.notes: Each year under a master gives 30 xp on Arcane and Academic Abilities and the Arts, with charms at 5 levels per xp (Skilled Master +50, Poorly Trained Magician -50); the book sets no length, so spend it as Later Life xp. Only a Gifted master can Open the Arts; an unGifted member is initiated.

casting.name: Known charm
casting.vis: Tueor as Rego, Succurro as Creo, Vulnero as Perdo, Fortunam and Magicam as Vim, Salutem as Corpus, Herbam, Animal or Mentem
casting.notes: A stress die when under pressure. Strong and Weak Verbal Charms change the divisor. No spontaneous charms. Drawn as a tattoo or chalk sign (Slow Caster).

casting.name: Charm from a text
casting.notes: 2 minutes a magnitude to read (x2 below Language 4, x4 at 2 or less); +1 botch die per point of Language below 5.

casting.name: Imhergi Lab Total
casting.notes: Inventing charms and making amulets and chartae.

Magicam.against: Vim effects cast on his charms

dispels.name: Shorten a continuing effect
dispels.notes: the charm's level + a stress die + 10 must reach twice the effect's Casting Total; it drops one Duration step

opening.notes: The master's Succurro Magicam Lab Total (with Craft: Tattoo). UnGifted students are initiated instead.

advancement.notes: Books on their Arts use the usual rules; they may not study from vis.

warping.name: Intervention and Abduction
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points from a botch.
warping.notes: Avoid it: Intelligence + Concentration + Magicam / 5 + stress die vs Warping Score + Warping Points gained + (Realm) aura + stress die. If not avoided, appease the entity: Communication + stress die vs Warping Score + stress die; success may bring a boon, failure a punishment (lost charms for a time, or abduction to a regio). At Warping Score 10 the loss is permanent.

activities.summary: A season making a lasting tattoo or inscription that works when uncovered, in place of an amulet or charta.

entries.name: Inenden
entries.description: The Tuareg's outcast craftsmen, smiths, woodcarvers, saddlers and jewellers, some of whom make wondrous items for one named customer each.
entries.notes: UnGifted; many have Offensive to Animals or Magical Air. The realm is chosen per character (Touched by the realm). Virtues: Inenden Crafter, Touched by (Realm) (two Forms), Mythic Saddle-Maker and its kin, Crafter's Eye (= Eye of Hephaestus). A wondrous item is made for one named customer and is an Arcane Connection to him; only he can use it. It has no Penetration (works on no one with Magic Resistance), one effect, Personal or Touch, up to Sun, Individual, within the crafter's Forms. Craft Level = 12 + the equivalent Hermetic effect's magnitude + the uses-a-day modifier. Superior items give +1 to one roll; excellent ones more, for one user.

casting.name: Workshop Total
casting.notes: Characteristic + Craft + aura + Shape & Material and Design & Inscription bonuses (each capped by the Craft) + half one helper's Craft. Mythic Saddle-Makers fix Int or Dex at creation; the Characteristic here may need changing. Rolled against the Craft Level.

activities.label: Make a wondrous item
activities.summary: Seasons accumulating Workshop Total - Craft Level until the points reach the Craft Level; no other seasonal work.

entries.name: Bouda (folk witches)
entries.description: A Moroccan clan of hyena-witches, usually men: Faerie-aligned folk witches who curse, entrance and heal, take the shape of the hyena, and work wood and iron magically.
entries.notes: Built as Hedge Magic RE folk witches. Required: Folk Witch, Sex Shift (Gender Shift), Theriomorph, Touched by Faerie Realm; Judged Unfairly, Short-Ranged Curses, Primitive Tradition. Skinchanger (hyena) is a Virtue, treated as a favored power. Also blacksmithing or woodcarving magic (usually Muto Terram or Muto Herbam), sometimes Animal Healing or Summon Animals. Most are Gifted; unGifted descendants of bouda or the Faerie-touched join by initiation, with Ordeals such as Feral Scent, Disfigured, Hunchback, Tainted by Evil or Repellent. Bouda Blood is the Faerie Blood of their line.

training.notes: A witch must take at least one Flaw affecting their magic. After apprenticeship they have 15 xp a year (Wealthy or Poor change it), and each lab season at creation costs 10 of that year's xp, at most 2 a year (Wealthy 3, Poor 1).

casting.notes: Each power is worked by its Method: Potion (drunk), Incantation (heard) or Fetish (held). A botch gives a Warping Point per 0.
casting.botch_notes: +1 Warping Point a 0; a Flight botch costs a Long-Term Fatigue level a botch (HMRE pp. 37-38)

casting.name: Folk witch Lab Total
casting.notes: A season in her kitchen (a standard laboratory). Some work uses no Supernatural Ability: then Int + Folk Witch Magic Theory + aura.

opening.notes: A sabbat Opening adds +1 for each assisting Gifted witch, up to the aura.

advancement.notes: Her powers are Supernatural Abilities on the Ability table, practised like any Ability. After apprenticeship, 15 xp a year.

warping.notes: In place of the Witch's Moon, rising Warping slowly turns him into a Faerie bouda, as a gruagach turns into a troll (Hedge Magic RE).

bonds.how: A season's lab work: her Animal Ken Lab Total must exceed 10 + the animal's Size + its Magic Might. One familiar at a time.
bonds.feeds: Her Lab Totals: the familiar's Intelligence + its Folk Witch Magic Theory.
bonds.notes: Both gain True Friend and Loyal +3; the familiar gains human Intelligence (-3 if it had none) and her languages, ages only when she does, and each is an Arcane Connection to the other with no Magic Resistance between them.

entries.name: Bedouin Hakima
entries.description: The wise women and soothsayers (hakima, kahina) of the Bedouin tribes: Faerie-aligned folk witches who heal people and beasts, entrance, find water and see the hidden, and lead their tribe's Muru'a cult.
entries.notes: Built as Hedge Magic RE folk witches, aligned to Faerie. The unGifted usually lack Cursing and Flight and have Animal Healing and Entrancement in their place (the favored list here); a Gifted hakima may keep Cursing and Flight. Shai'ir poets and 'abqari poets with a qareen are Mythic Companions (Legendary Artist, Maestro), not members.

warping.name: The Witch Moon
warping.trigger: Each rise in the Warping Score.
warping.notes: A month (at least) without her Supernatural Abilities, with a fever that gives a Medium Wound. At each month's end, Stamina - Warping Score + stress die vs 6 ends it; a failure adds a Warping Point and another month, a botch Warping Points equal to its 0s. More months than her Warping Score is a bad experience (lost xp, a Minor Flaw), otherwise a good one (5 xp per month, a Minor Virtue, or a new Supernatural Ability at 1). A botch with a Supernatural Ability gives a Warping Point per 0.

It initiates Faerie-aligned Virtues: Animal Ken, Art of Memory, Arcadian Travel, Cursing, Death Prophecy, Dowsing, Enchanting Poetry (the usual Major), Entrancement, Greater Immunity: Thirst, Puissant Arabic, Spiritual Pact, Ways of the Desert, Wilderness Sense. entries.name: Murabitin
entries.description: The holy men of the Maghreb (murabit, agurram): scholars, dream readers, shrine keepers and amulet makers, a mystic tradition of the Divine whom the Order counts as hedge wizards.
entries.notes: Required: Murabit (a paid Minor Social Status), Pious, Vow. Talib is the Minor Status of a student-follower. Usually taught father to son, or by adoption; the book gives no apprenticeship xp, yearly xp or Opening (Realms of Power: The Divine's mystic traditions fill in). A Minor amulet lasts Dex + Craft Amulets + a simple die days; Design & Inscription bonuses may be used within the Craft Amulets cap. Berber dream houses at ancestor tombs give +3 to Dream Interpretation for dreams had there. Failed holy effects risk tragedies of hubris.

casting.name: Holy effect (dream)
casting.notes: Dream Interpretation stands in for Meditation as the Method: an hour's prayer, a night's sleep, then max(1, 6 - Dream Interpretation) hours of thought. No vis; a falling short risks a tragedy of hubris.

casting.name: Dream divination
casting.notes: Same preparation; Int + Dream Interpretation (+ Premonitions) against the level of the matching Momentary non-Ritual Intellego spell. The roll as printed adds no die and no aura.

casting.name: Major amulet
casting.notes: Dex + Craft Amulets + Holy Method + Holy Power + shape and material bonus + Dominion aura; accumulate total - level each season until the points reach the level. Penetration 0 unless connections are embedded.

casting.name: Minor amulet
casting.notes: Dex + Craft Amulets + shape and material bonus + Dominion aura must reach twice the effect's level; max(1, 12 - Craft Amulets) hours.

groups.name: Ceremony
groups.notes: Realms of Power: The Divine's Ceremony.

activities.label: Make a Major amulet
activities.summary: Seasons accumulating the Major amulet total - the effect's level; one Major amulet a season.

entries.name: Sorginak
entries.description: Basque witches who serve the goddess Mari. They are folk witches with their own twists: Hex in place of Cursing, incantations spoken in Euskara, monthly akelarre gatherings, and darker Inner Mysteries (Goetic Arts, Ecstatic Magic, a chthonic magic taught by Mari). Gifted or unGifted; male witches (sorgin) are rare.
entries.notes: Built as folk witches (Hedge Magic RE) with these changes. Hex (or Cursing) is the seventh favored Ability; Skinchanger may stand in for Shapeshifter, Wilderness Sense for Hex or another, and Premonitions comes paired with the Visions Flaw at no extra cost. Sorgina may be taken with Hermetic Magus and most other Social Statuses, but not with any Witch's Moon Virtue or Flaw. No Magical Focus: Potent Magic replaces it. Hex, Chthonic Magic and the Goetic Arts carry an Infernal taint that only Divine and Infernal powers can sense. Inner Mysteries: the Goetic Arts Summoning (Pre, Vim, Incantation; Immovable Object vs effects that move or conjure her) and Commanding (Com, Vim, Incantation; Immovable Object vs effects that control her), Ecstatic Magic, Chthonic Sorginak Magic, and an undescribed sorginak Ceremony. Methods: Potion with Animal Ken, Dowsing, Ecstatic Magic, Flight, Healing, Premonitions, Second Sight, Shapeshifter, Wilderness Sense; Incantation (in Euskara) with all but Ecstatic Magic; Fetish with Dowsing, Flight, Hex, Shapeshifter, Wilderness Sense and the Skinchanger Virtue. Premonitions' defense is Fluctuating Fortune (Art & Academe), which the app doesn't model. Male sorgin usually take Social Handicap, Poorly Trained Folk Witch and a Flaw on their magic.

training.notes: As folk witches: a Gifted sorgina leaves training with all seven favored Abilities; an unGifted one buys each as its Virtue. A few Gifted sorginak are trained Hermetically instead (the Hermetic sorginak of House Ex Miscellanea).

casting.name: Sorgina powers
casting.vis: the Ability's Form, besides any the effect itself costs
casting.notes: The folk witch power rules, through Potion, Incantation or Fetish. Premonitions works through a daily prayer and its visions come in dreams. A botch gives a Warping Point per 0.

casting.name: Hex
casting.vis: Vim
casting.notes: EF = Severity (Minor 6, Serious 12, Major 18, Critical 24, Terminal 30) + Duration or lifting condition (Momentary +0, Hour/Simple +3, Day/Minor +6, Moon/Moderate +9, Season/Major +12, Year/Ultimate +15) + Delay (Moment +12, Hour +9, Day +6, Week +3, Month 0, Season -3, Year -6, Generation -9, Lifetime -12). Incantation needs eye contact or touch and the target hearing the rhyme. A Fetish holds an Arcane Connection, takes a season to make, holds one hex fixed when made and is set off later from any distance. Fetish and incantation together, within Eye or Touch: +1 Penetration multiplier. The book doesn't restate Hex's Penetration or vis use; the folk witch rules are assumed.

casting.name: Ecstatic straying
casting.notes: Only during akelarre. EF 12 to leave the body as an intangible spirit for an hour, +1 hour per 3 points over. Travel: Sta + Athletics vs 3 (seen daily), 6 (this week), 9 (this year), 12 (longer ago), 15 (never visited, with an Arcane Connection). Becoming tangible: Sta + Concentration vs 12. While straying her Second Sight equals her Ecstatic Magic; nightwalker limits apply, but she cannot take others, change form or touch dreamers.

casting.name: Sorgina Lab Total
casting.notes: The folk witch kitchen laboratory. With Chthonic Sorginak Magic she adds Chthonic Magic to Folk Witch Magic Theory for the pawns of Infernal vis she may use in a season, and a knowingly blasphemous act gives +6 and lets Casting Items' Shape and Material bonuses (up to Folk Witch Magic Theory) add.

Animal Ken.against: effects cast by casters in animal form

Hex.against: effects aimed at her by Voice or through an Arcane Connection

Ecstatic Magic.against: effects on her mind or controlling her body

groups.name: Akelarre
groups.notes: The sorginak sabbat, held at least one Friday a month (every Friday for active covens) in caves or stone circles, with grand sabbats now and then. Works as the folk witch Sabbat.

opening.notes: The folk witch Opening, at an akelarre: +1 for each assisting Gifted witch, up to the aura.

initiation.notes: Initiations happen at akelarre by the folk witch rules. Most scripts hold pagan elements; 'clean' versions exist for many favored Abilities. The book prints no sorginak scripts.

advancement.notes: As folk witches: Supernatural Abilities on the Ability table; 15 xp a year after training.

activities.label: Brew a potion or make a fetish
activities.summary: A season in her kitchen making a potion, salve, incense or fetish with one of her powers.

activities.label: Prepare a hex fetish
activities.summary: A season binding one hex, fixed now, into a fetish holding an Arcane Connection to the victim; set off later from any distance.

bonds.name: Familiar
bonds.how: As folk witches: a season's lab work, her Animal Ken Lab Total exceeding 10 + the animal's Size + its Magic Might.
bonds.feeds: Her Lab Totals: the familiar's Intelligence + its Folk Witch Magic Theory.
bonds.notes: Faith & Flame doesn't restate familiars; the folk witch rule is assumed.

warping.name: Ecstatic Catharsis
warping.trigger: Gaining 2 or more Warping Points at once.
warping.notes: Only the 'True Sorginak' lineages; other sorginak suffer the folk witch Witch's Moon. Avoid: Sta + Concentration + Premonitions + stress die vs Warping Score + points gained + Ecstatic Magic + aura (success: calm in 40 rounds - (margin + Second Sight); botch: Catharsis with Debasement). Else assimilate: Int + Ecstatic Magic + stress die vs Warping Score + stress die; success is an Epiphany (Warping Score + simple die xp in a Supernatural Ability, a new sorginak Ability or Virtue, or a lamia Virtue), failure a Debasement (that much xp lost, a Supernatural or Hermetic Flaw, or a lamia Flaw). Helpless an hour per Warping Score point; spending a Confidence Point rolls Per + Second Sight + stress die off the hours. At Warping Score 10 she becomes a lamia and leaves play.

entries.name: The Forest Paths
entries.description: A way of gaining supernatural (and, for magi, Hermetic) Virtues by a pact with a great forest's spirit. The walker reaches communion with the genius locus, takes a Flaw as Sacrifice, serves on a Quest, and then receives a Virtue as the Fruit. Open to magi, Gifted or unGifted companions and, rarely, mundanes.
entries.notes: The realm is the forest spirit's: the Hercynian spirits are Magic, but Faerie, Divine and Infernal forests exist. Forest Lore also counts as the forest's Area Lore; a foreign spirit-forest needs a score 3 higher (or +3 EF). Forest Lore 1 lets him enter communion, 3 find vis, 5 speak with the spirit directly, 6 be its acknowledged ally. The first Fruit is Minor; later ones Minor or Major, matched by the Sacrifice. The walker earns no xp from a Quest (helpers do); a Minor Quest takes about two seasons or less, a Major one many. A Fruit is permanent, lets an unGifted character hold Supernatural Virtues and costs a Gifted one no penalty; spells a Fruit makes possible need Forest Lore to invent and cast. Path of the Heartbeast is the Bjornaer heartbeast (Sacrifice: never binding a familiar); the common Arcadian Path leads to Faerie Magic. Thief of Emotions grants Emotion Theft 1.

training.notes: No apprenticeship: Forest Lore is learned only by living, studying or hunting in the forest (Source Quality = its aura), and paths are walked in play.

casting.name: Seek communion
casting.notes: EF 9, one attempt a season, usually at the spirit's place of greatest power; needs Forest Lore 1 (4 in a foreign forest). Communion may also come by chance. The book doesn't name the die.

casting.name: Emotion Theft
casting.notes: From Thief of Emotions. EF 6 + the target's Trait for the emotion (+3 for true love or true friendship; true faith can't be taken). Success removes the emotion; a touch gives it to another at the donor's strength. The book gives no Penetration or die rule; the usual Supernatural Ability rules are assumed.

initiation.notes: No Initiation Total: at communion the walker takes the Sacrifice Flaw at once, and gains the Fruit Virtue when the Quest is done. The storyguide may invent paths and Virtues; these are the book's examples, all for magi.

scripts.name: Path of Aging, first step
scripts.notes: Quest: a Longevity Ritual using rare forest ingredients and a blood sacrifice.

scripts.name: Path of Aging, second step
scripts.notes: Quest: drink from the Fountain of Youth.

scripts.name: Path of Energy, first step
scripts.notes: Quest: live a year in the forest as an animal, without clothes, cooked food, tools or magic.

scripts.name: Path of Energy, second step
scripts.notes: Quest: kill the Dragon of the Sauerland and eat its heart.

scripts.name: Path of Warping, first step
scripts.notes: Quest: reach Warping Score 4.

scripts.name: Path of Warping, second step
scripts.notes: Quest: trap a magus hostile to the forest in Twilight.

scripts.name: Arcadian Path (Serrifuloria), first step
scripts.notes: After Faerie Magic. Quest: make an important faerie show an emotion it doesn't usually feel.

scripts.name: Arcadian Path (Serrifuloria), second step
scripts.notes: Quest: enchant four jewels holding the emotions of heart, liver, spleen and brain.

advancement.notes: Forest Lore advances only by practice in the forest.

activities.label: Seek communion with a forest spirit
activities.summary: A season in the forest trying to reach communion with its genius locus (Int + Forest Lore vs 9), to begin or continue a path.

bonds.name: Forest pact
bonds.how: Communion with the forest's genius locus: a Sacrifice (a Flaw) taken at once, then a Quest in the spirit's service.
bonds.feeds: The Fruit: a permanent Virtue matching the Sacrifice's size.
bonds.notes: Spirit-forests have Might 30 or more; their powers include Grant Virtue and Grant Flaw (which fade away from the forest, unlike a Fruit), Oath-Swearing, Healing, Guide and Regio.

entries.name: Branchidae
entries.description: A Gifted bloodline of House Ex Miscellanea, descended from Branchos, who serve the faerie oracle of Apollo at Didyma. They interpret an oracle's visions into written prophecies that help whoever reads them.
entries.notes: Hermetic magi of House Ex Miscellanea (joined 990); their patron is a powerful faerie, Apollo Didyma. Only Gifted blood descendants; unGifted Branchidae are covenfolk. A prophecy: an Arcane Connection to the subject (a person, or a member of a bloodline; a place or nation needs none), Sacred Spring water with 1 pawn of any vis transferred in (a day's lab work), drunk by an oracle with the Visions Flaw (Gifted or not), who trances about an hour; the Branchidae interprets it in about a day into a text copied like a level 5 Lab Text, with an expiry. Valid prophecies at once per subject: grog 1, companion or magus up to 3, Mythic Blood up to 6, place, bloodline or nation usually 1. The book lists Death Prophecy as a Major Supernatural Virtue; the catalog's DE entry is used.

training.notes: Built as a Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea: the tradition package (Death Prophecy, Branchidae Prophecy, Weak Spontaneous Magic) comes with Opening the Arts, on top of the usual allowance. Branchidae Prophecy can be gained no other way.

pools.name: Prophecy Points
pools.income: 1 for each different prophecy text he reads or hears (not a reread, a duplicate or a falsified one).
pools.costs: 1 for a one-off +3 to a roll about the prophecy's subject (+6 if the subject is a faerie).
pools.notes: Each point lapses when its prophecy expires.

entries.name: Corrguineach
entries.description: Irish magi of House Ex Miscellanea who summon, bargain with and command elemental spirits. They are the Hermetic Sahirs' tradition moved to Hibernia, with Sihr as their tradition Art.
entries.notes: Through the Aegis prints only character stats and points to HoH: Societates, whose 'Ringing the Changes' makes them the Hermetic Sahirs relocated, so the Sihr rules (Discern, Summon, Bargain) are the Hermetic Sahirs' with elemental spirits for jinn; the Minor Magical Focus is elemental spirits. Both printed magi also have Elemental Magic; Puissant Sihr and Cautious with Sihr are seen. Sihr is an Accelerated Ability (Art table) and can be studied from books. Each Name of Power he knows is an Arcane Connection to one spirit (track as a list). He may give his bound spirits Aegis tokens. Discern: Int + Area Lore vs 6, then Int + realm Lore + stress die vs 9 for the spirit's Might magnitude.

training.notes: Built as a Hermetic magus of House Ex Miscellanea: Sihr, Minor Magical Focus (elemental spirits) and Twilight Prone come free on top of the usual allowance.

casting.name: Summon a spirit
casting.notes: EF = the spirit's Might; Penetration must reach its Might (its home is an Arcane Connection, +1 multiplier). At least 15 minutes; each further 15 minutes gives +2 Penetration, +1 botch die and -1 Fatigue level afterwards. Summoning Strength = total - EF. Vis (a fitting Form, standard 1 pawn per Might magnitude, 1 up to Sihr score) changes only the bargain.

casting.name: Bargain with a spirit
casting.notes: Adds the Summoning Strength. EF 18 + scope (general +3, specific 0, single task -3) + length (day -3, week 0, month +3, season +6, year +9) + duty he accepts (simple -3, onerous -6) +2 per pawn below the standard vis, -2 per pawn above. A botch gives Supernatural Nuisance or Plagued by Supernatural Entity for a month or more.

bonds.name: Bound spirit
bonds.how: A struck bargain, magically enforced, until the spirit spends its last Might point for him or he fails his duty.
bonds.feeds: Its powers (it mimics spells of its element up to its Might); after a season's service it can teach Sihr, its Form or its realm Lore at Source Quality 3 x its Might magnitude, once each.
bonds.notes: At most Leadership spirits (at least 1) serve him at once.

entries.name: Children of Olympos
entries.description: Lucian the Scholar's Hermetic league in the Theban Tribunal, whose members channel the Greek gods (powerful faeries) in ecstatic rites, taking on a god's traits and, with the Olympian Pact, its powers.
entries.notes: A Mystery with no prerequisite: no Cult Lore or Outer Mystery is needed, and Lucian's script works for anyone while he is mystagogue. Only Lucian has the Olympian Pact (Major Supernatural; Ordeal a Major Personality Flaw suiting the god); its script isn't printed. Sympathy Trait points buy Traits as if Arts (6 points: one at +3 or two at +2); a Sympathy Trait replaces the specialty of a fitting Ability but makes the roll a stress roll (RoP: Faerie).

training.notes: Joined by Initiation, not apprenticeship.

casting.name: Channel a god
casting.fatigue: A failure: she collapses with 1 Long-Term Fatigue level per hour of preparation.
casting.notes: Adds the Characteristic that suits the god (not fixed, so none is set here), the aura, -3 to +3 for resemblance to the god and up to +3 if last season's deeds suited it, and +1 per extra hour of preparation beyond the first (at most Sta hours). EF 9: god's Personality Trait +2, 1 Sympathy point; 12: +3, 3 points, 1 minor power; 15: +4, 6 points, 2 minor; 18: +5, 10 points, 1 major or 3 minor; 21+: +6, 15 points, 2 major, 6 minor, or 1 major and 3 minor. Powers need the Olympian Pact. Everything lasts as many hours as the total rolled. A botch channels some other faerie.

initiation.notes: The book names no Lore for the Initiation Total.

scripts.name: Initiation of Elysian Ecstasy
scripts.notes: A boon from each of 12 powerful beings resonant with the twelve Olympians (+6); a rite at an Olympian shrine as Sirius rises (+3); the Ordeal (+3).

warping.name: Olympian Pact
warping.trigger: Each use of the Olympian Pact.
warping.notes: 1 Warping Point per use; Hermetic Twilight otherwise applies.

entries.name: Amazon Sorceresses
entries.description: Gifted women of Amazonia who sing incantations and rites in the unwritten Amazonian Chant, pairing three Vowels with five Consonants. Their spells reach targets by relationship rather than distance, must be aimed, and may be resisted; rites are made permanent with the sacrifice of magical animals.
entries.notes: Pagan; no Divine powers, though Faerie or Infernal Abilities are allowed. Every other Social Status is closed to Amazons; warriors take Amazon, men Amazonian Slave (a man secretly trained as a sorcerer takes Transvestite as a Major Story Flaw). Banned: Order of Hermes Lore and Organization Lores outside Amazonia, Dead Languages other than Amazonian Chant, Code of Hermes, Magic Theory, Parma Magica. Most Hermetic Virtues and Flaws are banned (allowed: Gentle Gift, Mythic Blood, Affinity with Art, Cautious Sorcerer, Cyclic Magic, Enduring Magic, Fast Caster, Life Boost, Puissant Art, Side Effect, Special Circumstances; Flaws Blatant Gift, Deficient Technique (a Vowel), Magic Addiction, Necessary Condition, Painful Magic, Restriction, Careless Sorcerer, Cyclic Magic, Deficient Form (a Consonant), Deleterious Circumstances, Disorientating Magic, Infamous Parens, Susceptibility to (Realm) Power, Warped Magic, Weird Magic); Clumsy Magic, Harnessed Magic, Short-Lived Magic and Unpredictable Magic become Major. Ranges are relationships: Personal, Sister, Cousin, Seen Stranger, Unseen Stranger (five identifiers); Durations Momentary, Exchange, Hour, Day, Month, multiplied by Amazonian Chant; the Target is always Individual, each Size step up or down +1 magnitude. Each Consonant has a free base Range and Duration (Api Cousin/Hour, Kardia Sister/Day, Nux Seen Stranger/Hour, Soma Seen Stranger/Momentary, Zoi Cousin/Hour); each step from it is +1 magnitude. Horses cannot be affected. No books and no vis study for Arts or Arcane Abilities; teaching between Gifted sorceresses takes -3 each. Vis only feeds captive magical animals for rites (Api vis: Terram, Herbam, Vim; Nux vis: Aquam, Auram, Vim); how much Might a pawn adds is not given.

training.notes: Fifteen years from about age 9 or 10: 240 xp for Abilities, Arts and spells, the minimums (40 xp) included, with at least 60 xp spent on spells; the book gives no xp-to-level rate. Her highest spell is her Temple Total for its Vowel and Consonant, worked out with aura 1. Older sorceresses take 30 xp a year, less 10 for each season spent on something else. No Art or magical Arcane Ability may rise until Amazonian Chant is at least 1. The Gift's teaching penalty between mistress and apprentice is -3, -2 after five years, -1 after ten and 0 at the end, if both work at it.

casting.name: Incantation
casting.fatigue: 1 short-term Fatigue level on a failure
casting.vis: none: vis only feeds sacrificial animals
casting.resistance: Stamina + stress die vs 6 + the spell's magnitude + the caster's Amazonian Chant (a magus adds his best Form bonus)
casting.notes: Sung in one round, no gestures, no requisites, no spontaneous magic. A scepter adds its score in its Consonant. Every spell must be aimed: Casting Total - level + Finesse (+ scepter) vs the target's Defense, or vs Personal 0, Sister 3, Cousin 6, Seen Stranger 9, Unseen Stranger 15. Penetration: Casting Total - level + Penetration, no multiplier. Each botch die rolled gives a Warping Point. Strong Magic makes the resistance base 9, Frail Magic 3.
casting.botch_notes: a Warping Point a 0; 2 or more bring the Sacred Sickness (RM p. 25)

casting.name: Rite
casting.fatigue: 1 long-term Fatigue level per 2 magnitudes for caster and assistants, success or failure (unconscious above magnitude 8)
casting.vis: sacrificed magical animals whose vis totals at least the rite's magnitude
casting.resistance: Stamina + stress die vs 6 + the spell's magnitude + the caster's Amazonian Chant
casting.notes: A permanent spell (Duration Month) needing at least one requisite Art. The caster's and assistants' Amazonian Cult Lore must sum to the rite's magnitude. Failure kills the animal for nothing; a botch rolls magnitude + aura botch dice. The target gains Warping Points equal to the magnitude (a sorceress subtracts her Cult Lore, minimum 1). A non-Magic sacrifice taints the rite.

casting.name: Temple Total
casting.notes: In her temple. A scepter adds its score in its Consonant. Learning (inventing) a spell gains Temple Total - level points a season until they reach the level; a Temple Total of twice the level takes one season.

Zoi.against: spells on her magical potential (The Gift)

Kardia.against: Personality Trait changes and mental control

opening.notes: The mistress's Alala Zoi Temple Total, a season's work; the apprentice gets all eight Arts at 0. Twice the Opening EF Opens her, losing her Supernatural Abilities; four times or more keeps them. Arts of any other tradition are always lost (Rival Magic p. 30).

initiation.notes: Self-initiation, a season in a temple. The Script Bonus she proposes stands if simple die + Risk Modifier + Int + Amazonian Cult Lore reaches 9 + that bonus and an Experimental Results roll finds no flaw; the Initiation Total (Pre + Amazonian Cult Lore + Script Bonus + Risk Modifier, no die) must reach the Target Level. Opening and making a first scepter also count as initiations.

scripts.name: The Centaur's Heart
scripts.gains: Horses ignore her Gift (a limited Inoffensive to Animals)
scripts.notes: The book gives a Target Level, not a printed Script Bonus.

scripts.name: The Living Goddess
scripts.gains: Transformed (Being), a magic human: no aging, Magic Might equal to her highest Art; she loses casting and her spells become powers
scripts.notes: The book gives a Target Level, not a printed Script Bonus.

advancement.notes: Arts and Arcane Abilities are oral: no books and no vis study. Teaching is Com + Teaching + 3 + bonus, with -3 for each Gifted party (friendly ghosts no penalty, hostile -6). Contemplation, a season casting an Art's incantations in trance in her temple, gives 4 + the Magic aura xp. Teaching and contemplation need a temple.

activities.label: Learn an incantation or rite
activities.summary: A season in her temple: Temple Total - level points toward the spell, done when they reach its level.

activities.label: Contemplation
activities.summary: A season in her temple casting one Art's incantations in trance: 4 + the Magic aura xp in that Art.

activities.label: Instill an incantation
activities.summary: A season putting one incantation into an item she crafted herself; the Temple Total must reach twice its final level.

activities.label: Make a scepter
activities.summary: A season making her scepter, attuned to one Consonant, and inflicting the self-wound (a Minor Flaw) the first time.

activities.label: Train her scepter
activities.summary: A season teaching her scepter: it gains Com + Amazonian Cult Lore xp, advancing as an Art, up to her own score in its Consonant.

bonds.name: Scepter
bonds.how: A season's making and a self-inflicted wound (a troupe-approved Minor Flaw) the first time; attuned for good to one Consonant. Replacing it by destroying the old one takes a season and no new wound.
bonds.feeds: Its score adds to her Casting Totals, Temple Totals and aiming rolls with its Consonant.
bonds.notes: Its score rises by seasons of 'teaching' (Com + Amazonian Cult Lore xp, as an Art), never above her Consonant. If others destroy it she takes stress die + its score damage, and a new one needs a new wound.

warping.name: The Sacred Sickness
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points in one event (usually botches).
warping.notes: It cannot be avoided: Warping Score + 1 rounds of helpless seizure. Overcoming it: Int + stress die vs Warping Score + stress die; extra Warping Points of simple die - Amazonian Cult Lore are added to the trigger's. Overcome: under 7 WP gives 2 x WP xp in the Arts used, 7 to 10 a Minor Virtue, over 10 a Major Virtue. Succumbed: lose 2 x WP xp from them, a Minor Flaw, or a Major Flaw. Keep two tallies (overcome and succumbed). Warping Score 10 is death; her ghost is friendly to Amazons if her overcome points exceed her succumbed ones, hostile otherwise.

guidelines.name: Summon earth elemental
guidelines.summary: general: summon earth elemental, Might equal to base level

guidelines.name: Greatly brighten sunlight
guidelines.summary: Strongly increase the sunlight in an area

guidelines.name: Create sunlight
guidelines.summary: Bring sunlight into an area that has none

guidelines.name: Subtly open earth
guidelines.summary: Open earth gently: a tremor or slow natural change

guidelines.name: Violently open earth
guidelines.summary: Rip open an amount of earth violently

guidelines.name: Control earth elemental
guidelines.summary: general: command earth elemental, Might equal to base level

guidelines.name: Vague mundane earth properties
guidelines.summary: Learn vague mundane facts about an area of earth

guidelines.name: Detailed mundane earth properties
guidelines.summary: Learn detailed mundane facts about an area of earth

guidelines.name: Vague magical earth properties
guidelines.summary: Sense an aura or raw vis in earth or earth product

guidelines.name: Detailed magical earth properties
guidelines.summary: Sense regio, aura strength, amount of vis in earth

guidelines.name: Destroy Might / bar creatures
guidelines.summary: general: destroy Might (earth elementals, melancholic beasts) or bar creatures of that Might

guidelines.name: Greatly dim sunlight
guidelines.summary: Strongly reduce the sunlight in an area

guidelines.name: Cancel sunlight
guidelines.summary: Remove sunlight from an area entirely

guidelines.name: Subtly close earth
guidelines.summary: Close an amount of earth gently

guidelines.name: Violently close earth
guidelines.summary: Close an amount of earth violently

guidelines.name: Raise trait / ease sickness
guidelines.summary: Personality Trait +1, or sick target's wound penalty -1; +1 per extra magnitude

guidelines.name: Trait to +2 / short-term Fatigue
guidelines.summary: Create trait at 1 or raise by 2 (max +2); regain short-term Fatigue level

guidelines.name: Trait to +3 / long-term Fatigue
guidelines.summary: Create trait at 2 or raise by 3 (max +3); regain long-term Fatigue level

guidelines.name: Create trait +3
guidelines.summary: Create a Personality Trait at +3

guidelines.name: Identify disease spirit
guidelines.summary: general: name the disease spirit possessing someone; base level at least its Might

guidelines.name: Sense strong trait
guidelines.summary: Reveal a Personality Trait of +3 or more (or -3 or less)

guidelines.name: Sense moderate trait / exhaustion
guidelines.summary: Reveal a +2/-2 trait, or a human's state of exhaustion

guidelines.name: Sense weak trait
guidelines.summary: Reveal a +1/-1 Personality Trait

guidelines.name: Lower trait 1 / drain Fatigue
guidelines.summary: Trait -1, or target loses a short-term Fatigue level

guidelines.name: Lower trait 2 / drain two Fatigue
guidelines.summary: Trait -2, or target loses two short-term Fatigue levels

guidelines.name: Lower trait 3 / long-term Fatigue
guidelines.summary: Trait -3 (maximum), or target loses a long-term Fatigue level

guidelines.name: Summon air elemental
guidelines.summary: general: summon air elemental, Might at most the base level

guidelines.name: Deepen darkness
guidelines.summary: Increase the darkness in an area

guidelines.name: Full darkness / mild weather
guidelines.summary: Total darkness in a lit area, or a normal mild weather event

guidelines.name: Severe weather
guidelines.summary: Create severe weather, worsen mild to severe, or unnatural mild weather

guidelines.name: Very severe weather
guidelines.summary: Create very severe weather, worsen severe, or unnatural severe weather

guidelines.name: Unnatural very severe weather
guidelines.summary: Create very severe weather that behaves unnaturally

guidelines.name: Command air elemental
guidelines.summary: general: command air elemental, Might at most the base level

guidelines.name: Vague mundane sky properties
guidelines.summary: Learn vague mundane facts about an area of sky

guidelines.name: Detailed mundane sky properties
guidelines.summary: Learn detailed mundane facts about an area of sky

guidelines.name: Vague magical sky properties
guidelines.summary: Sense an aura or raw vis in the sky

entries.name: Augustan Brotherhood
entries.description: Court wizards in Virgil's tradition who serve noble patrons while secretly working for an emperor of their choosing. They divine with the Aeneid (Sortes Virgilianae), lay slow Vigilo rites that ward a place until a trigger, and awaken crafted animations.
entries.notes: Hermetic Virtues and Flaws are banned except Gentle Gift, Inoffensive to Animals, Personal Vis Source, Side Effect, Twilight Prone (it exposes him to the Gates of Avernus), Blatant Gift and Susceptibility to Divine, Faerie or Infernal Power. Only three seasons a year are his; the fourth serves the employer (rites, animations, divinations). Limits: no spontaneous magic, no enchanted devices, Longevity Rituals, talismans or familiars, no Personal Range or Circle Duration, never cast on himself, never harm a human directly; rites need the School and the rite at 1 or more and are narrow (one rite per city or boundary); no Artes Liberales or Philosophiae in ritual totals and no sympathy bonuses. Each rite is its own Art (Virgilian Rite: name). Books written by wizards use the normal rules. The Schools given at Opening are stated two ways (one chosen School at 1, or all six at 0).

training.notes: Simplified build: 7 Characteristic points, up to 10 points of Virtues and Flaws, childhood and earlier years at 15 xp a year, then 12 years giving the minimum scores (160 xp: Latin 5, Artes Liberales 4, Virgilian Theory 3, Organization Lore 1) and 288 xp (Generous Master +72), counted together here as 448. Academic and Arcane Abilities are allowed, Parma Magica is not. Opening gives Sortes Virgilianae 1 and Animo 1 (not 0) and the Schools (one at 1, or all six at 0: the book says both). Experienced wizards: 30 xp a year, or 10 per free season; setting up a lab takes two seasons.

casting.name: Sortes Virgilianae
casting.fatigue: 1 long-term Fatigue level
casting.notes: Needs a full copy of the Aeneid; at least 3 minutes x EF. Bonuses (they stack): a personage with Reputation 5+ +3, ships +2, sieges +3, cities +3, kingdoms +3, Carthage, Rome or Troy +5. A failed question cannot be asked again that day. Penetration: Divination Total + Penetration - EF. EFs run 9 (an animal's image, detect an aura) to 24 (an item's magical properties).
casting.botch_notes: a Warping Point a 0 (RM p. 65)

casting.name: Vigilo rite
casting.fatigue: always 1 long-term Fatigue level; on a failure, (EF - (Casting Total + Sta)) / 3 more, rounded down
casting.vis: rituals only: EF / 6 pawns (rounded up) of a fitting Art
casting.notes: Adds the rite's score and its School. Ceil(EF / 6) x 15 minutes to cast. A ritual if EF is 33+, Target Boundary or City, or Duration Year. Normal voice -6, soft -12, impeded movement -3. Penetration: Casting Total + Penetration - EF (Target Pentagram: +5 to the multiplier). Cast at Touch on a warded area; it waits for its trigger and must penetrate the initiator. Each R/D/T step is +3 EF.
casting.botch_notes: a Warping Point a 0 (RM p. 65)

casting.name: Rite learning
casting.notes: A lab season's xp in one rite: Int + Virgilian Theory + a similar rite's score / 5 (rounded up) + aura. No casting, vis or botch dice. Schools cannot be raised this way.

casting.name: Awaken an animation
casting.notes: A season: vs the animation's Might, +6 if mobile, +6 if aware. Failure: retry next season at +1 cumulative. A botch destroys it, leaves it uncontrolled or lets a demon in. Success reveals its True Name.
casting.botch_notes: a Warping Point a 0 (RM p. 65)

casting.name: Inscribe a rite
casting.vis: EF / 6 pawns (rounded up) of a fitting Art
casting.notes: Adds Animo, the School and the item's Shape and Material bonus; a divination uses Sortes Virgilianae instead of a School. The total accumulates season by season until it reaches the EF, which may be at most twice the animation's Might. Uses per day: 2 +3, 6 +6, 24 +9, unlimited +12.

opening.notes: Done by the Grandmaster or the master in the regio of Virgil's tomb, with a ceremonial wand and Organization Lore 1. The initiate has Visions for a year, and his new copy of the Aeneid, bearing his magical name, is an Arcane Connection to him.

advancement.notes: Schools, rites and Sortes Virgilianae can be practised (practice needs no casting, vis or botch dice); rites also by teaching, a tractatus or a lab season. The Aeneid is a Sortes Virgilianae summa (level 10, Quality 8). After apprenticeship 24 xp a year, or 30 for experienced wizards.

activities.label: Learn a rite
activities.summary: A lab season: Int + Virgilian Theory + similar rite / 5 + aura xp in one rite.

activities.label: Prepare an animation
activities.summary: Seasons investing vis in an excellent-quality object: material base x Size multiplier pawns, at most (Animo + Virgilian Theory) x 2 a season.

activities.label: Awaken an animation
activities.summary: A season: Pre + Animo + Virgilian Theory + aura + stress die vs Might (+6 mobile, +6 aware).

activities.label: Inscribe a rite in an animation
activities.summary: Lab seasons accumulating Int + Virgilian Theory + School + Animo + Shape and Material + aura until it reaches the rite's EF.

activities.label: Serve the employer
activities.summary: The season a year owed to the noble employer: rites, animations and divinations for him.

bonds.name: Animation
bonds.how: An excellent-quality object (at most Animo materials) filled with vis over seasons, then awakened with Pre + Animo + Virgilian Theory + aura + stress die vs its Might (+6 mobile, +6 aware).
bonds.feeds: It obeys its maker and can hold inscribed rites (EF up to twice its Might); its Magic Might gives it some Magic Resistance.
bonds.notes: Base Magic Might (10 + Size + material base points) / 2. A new animation has 7 points of Characteristics and one General or Martial Ability at 3; it never speaks and has no Gift or magical Abilities. Taught, it gains Advancement Total - Might a season (each pawn spent cancels 2), its Abilities summing to at most Might + Int. Damaging its animating principle ends it; spotting that is Per + Magic Lore vs 12 (6 with Animo).

warping.name: Fated Destiny
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points in one event; botches with rites, Animo or Sortes Virgilianae give a Warping Point per zero.
warping.notes: The first time: Attention Avoidance, Int + (Realm) Lore + stress die vs Warping Score + WP gained + aura + stress die. Failing draws a powerful entity, and then and at every later 2+ WP event he Entreats the Fates: Com + stress die vs Warping Score + stress die, until stories resolve it. Favored by Fortune: a fitting Minor Virtue (first usually Premonitions), 5 to 10 xp in a Lore, rite or Supernatural Ability, or for large gains a Major Virtue. Cursed by the Fates: first Minor Flaw Visions, first Major Plagued by Supernatural Entity, then others. Warping Score 7 brings Gates of Avernus trances and Flaws for past wrongs to the dead; 10 a story ending in his death.

entries.name: Muspelli
entries.description: Pagan sorcerers sworn to one of the imprisoned jotnar. The patron Opens their Gift to six Supernatural Abilities, and in giant form (the etin-mod) they work hours-long utiseta rituals that enlarge those powers and wear down the auras that bind the giants.
entries.notes: All Muspelli are Gifted companions: The Gift free, up to 10 points of Virtues balanced by Flaws. The favored Abilities are six of these, set by the patron: four of the jotun's own and a pair from one ally. Aegir: Storm's Eye, Sjonhverfing, Threads of Fate, Dowsing (ally pair Wildfire + Winter's Breath, or Hex + Summon Animals); Gullveig: Entrancement, Hex, Summon Animals, Magic Sensitivity (Valgaldrar + Spadomur, or Shapeshifter + Winter's Breath); Gymir: Storm's Eye, Winter's Breath, Wildfire, Wilderness Sense (Shapeshifter + Sjonhverfing, or Sjonhverfing + Threads of Fate); Leikin: Hex, Spadomur, Valgaldrar, Second Sight (Entrancement + Summon Animals, or Entrancement + Threads of Fate); Nidhogg & Fenrir: Shapeshifter, Summon Animals, Winter's Breath, Animal Ken (Storm's Eye + Wildfire, or Sjonhverfing + Wildfire); Surtur: Shapeshifter, Sjonhverfing, Wildfire and the Virtue Lesser Craft Magic (Storm's Eye + Winter's Breath, or Summon Animals + Winter's Breath); Urdur: Entrancement, Spadomur, Threads of Fate, Premonitions (Hex + Summon Animals, or Sjonhverfing + Storm's Eye). Each patron's initiatory Major Flaw (Crippled, Blind, Horrifying Appearance (Three Heads), Enfeebled, Mute, Deaf, Low Self-Esteem) may be taken at Opening. Other Supernatural Abilities come from Virtues at creation. They work alone, with no Gift-shielding. The etin-mod: one round to change, no roll; +up to 3 to Str/Sta/Dex/Qik, Giant Blood, Greater Immunity (sleep), Greater Magical Defenses, General Flaws dropped, two Mundane Qualities, +3 Soak, -6 social; held by an hourly Deprivation roll on its Stamina. Gleipnir: every use of a Supernatural Ability uses its score - Gleipnir, and at 0 or less it cannot be used. Spadomur also gives Veil of Secrecy against Corpus and Imaginem (a defense the app does not model). Breaking the jotnar's chains: a successful utiseta of EF 5 x Faerie aura, 10 x Magic aura or 20 x Infernal aura lowers it by 1 (Divine immune); a Magic aura's lost point becomes Trolldomur alignment. Muspelli Lore is Organization Lore: Muspelli. Dies Irae extends this tradition (another wave). Dies Irae adds: a utiseta can corrupt an aura to Trolldomur (EF at least 5 x a Faerie aura or 10 x a Magic aura; each success lowers it by 1 and realigns it; a Divine aura is immune, an Infernal one nearly so); summoning an Aspect of Fimbulwinter is a utiseta on Int + Muspelli Lore against EF 50; a utiseta stored in a gandur lasts at most a year with its target fixed; and once the einherjar wake, every Heipt roll fails. The etin-mod's design (Rival Magic pp. 83-84), checked: with Giant Blood or Large already, it is Size +3 with a further +2 Strength and -1 Quickness; Weak Characteristics' lost points return in it; it has no Aging Characteristic loss or Decrepitude; the hourly Deprivation roll's Fatigue is long-term and its penalties fall on the human form; an Incapacitating Wound from it forces human form, breaks any ritual and raises Gleipnir to its next level.

training.notes: A Muspelli teaches a Gifted child Organization Lore: Muspelli 1 in a season, then summons the patron's Aspect, which Opens the Gift and grants six favored Supernatural Abilities (no scores) and a mutual Arcane Connection. Six years by the sacred site give 240 xp on any Abilities; afterwards a companion's xp each year. Each of the six favored Abilities must be at least 1 when he finishes; Concentration, Organization Lore: Muspelli, Dead Language: Jotun and Penetration are recommended. The patron's initiatory Major Flaw taken at Opening counts in the Flaw allowance.

casting.name: Ordinary use
casting.notes: Each Ability has its own Ease Factor table. The score used is Ability - Gleipnir. Hex adds a delay modifier (moment -12 to lifetime +12); Spadomur adds a reflection bonus (+3 if apt) and is rolled in secret; Threads of Fate's EF adds a simple die; Wildfire always rolls 2 extra botch dice.
casting.botch_notes: Wildfire adds 2 (RM p. 104)

casting.name: Utiseta
casting.vis: pawns start the ritual total and add a botch die each; lost if the ritual ends early
casting.notes: Only for Abilities granted by a Major Virtue, only in the etin-mod (etin-mod Characteristics). Casting Total = Characteristic + (Ability - Gleipnir) x Power Modifier + aura + stress die; the Power Modifier is 1 + one choice from each of Hamur (shape), Ond (power), Blot (sacrifice) and Litur (apparel). Gathering, each hour: Characteristic + (Ability - Gleipnir) + simple die vs 9, each point over adding to the ritual total until it reaches the EF. Each magnitude of R/D/T change is +3 EF (Decade +5, Lifetime +6 magnitudes over Momentary). Ending early: each 10 points missing is a botch die and a Warping Point. Penetration: Casting Total - EF + Penetration. No collaboration. One more hour stores the effect in a gandur of the patron for up to a year.
casting.botch_notes: ending a ritual early: a botch and a Warping Point a 10 points short (RM p. 91)

casting.name: Summoning the patron
casting.notes: About an hour at a site sacred to the patron, Magic aura 3+ (alignment may count), with a Gifted assistant; at most once a year. No die is added but a stress die is rolled: a botch draws a valkyrie and a Warping Point per zero. Purposes: Opening a novice (+aura, the Opening EF); Sacrifice of Power, taking the initiatory Flaw later (+the stress die, EF 15 - Warping Score); advice and a season's teaching (+aura, EF 6 + Source Quality, minimum 9); improving the etin-mod (+Script Bonus +3).

initiation.notes: Improving the etin-mod: a Summoning of the patron with one script per change, the Summoning Total (Int + Muspelli Lore + Script Bonus + 3 intrinsic) against the change's EF: Size +1 up to +5, or a Characteristic (not Int) +1 up to +5, 18 (30 above +5); natural weapon Attack or Defense +2, or Initiative or Damage +3, 18; a new Quality 15; a listed Minor Virtue 18; Greater Immunity or Ways of the (Land) 30. Weapon improvements do not stack.

scripts.notes: Find a Magic-Might giant of Size +5 or more and serve him a season; includes the +3 intrinsic bonus.

advancement.notes: His powers are Supernatural Abilities on the Ability table; after apprenticeship he takes a companion's yearly xp. The patron can teach a season in a Summoning.

activities.label: Summon the jotun patron
activities.summary: At most once a year at a sacred site: Opening a novice, a Sacrifice of Power, a season of teaching, or an etin-mod improvement.

bonds.name: Jotun patron
bonds.how: Its Aspect Opens his Gift at a sacred site and leaves a mutual Arcane Connection; he summons it with Int + Muspelli Lore at most once a year.
bonds.feeds: His six favored Supernatural Abilities, teaching, the etin-mod's improvements, and utiseta Power Modifiers (its initiatory Flaw, its gandar, its aligned auras).
bonds.notes: Patrons: Aegir (gandur a cauldron), Gullveig (a magical creature's scorched heart), Gymir (an eagle-feather cloak), Leikin (a knife from the underworld rivers), Nidhogg & Fenrir (a serpent's or wolf's tooth), Surtur (a sword of volcanic iron), Urdur (a silver sickle). Gandar must be quested for or stolen; they need not be enchanted.

pools.costs: Winning the duel takes the Warping Points gained off it as Heipt Points (not below 0).
pools.notes: A Trait from 0, advanced like an Ability by Heipt Points. Every use of a Supernatural Ability subtracts it from the score; at 0 or less the Ability cannot be used.

warping.name: Gleipnir and Heipt
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points in one event.
warping.notes: Heipt roll: Sta + (Realm) Lore + stress die vs Warping Score + WP gained + aura + stress die (no botch). Failure: a faerie sent by the gods (usually a valkyrie, Faerie Might 5 x Warping Score) duels him alone; wounds are glamour. Losing adds 2 x WP Heipt Points to Gleipnir; winning gives its vis, or a gipt: 2 x WP xp in his Supernatural Abilities and WP Heipt Points off Gleipnir. In a Divine aura an angel offers repentance, in an Infernal one a demon tempts. No Warping Virtues or Flaws.

entries.name: Soqotran Sorcerers
entries.description: The ruling caste of Soqotra: Gifted sorcerers of four tribes, each bound to a spirit ally and casting by incense ceremonies fed with vis from their tribe's sacred trees. Aloe heals and restores, Cinnabar protects, Myrrh grants traits, Olibanum commands.
entries.notes: Built like magi: The Gift free, 10 points of Flaws balanced by Virtues, and one free Minor Virtue, Puissant Magic in the tribe's style (+2 to casting; recorded as Puissant (Ability)). They do not reduce Source Quality for learning one another's styles. Artes Liberales is their cosmology (no Magic Theory). A starting character has a spirit ally only with his tribe's Ability at 5+; otherwise by a quest. Changing tribe is rare and impossible once an ally is bound. NPC guide: magus-age sorcerer 5 (+2) in his style, tribal leaders 9 (+2). Spell design: each Hermetic magnitude of R/D/T is 3 levels; Touch +3, Voice/Scent +6, Sight +9; Censer/Diameter/Concentration +3, Sun/Ring +6, Perpetual +12; Group +6, Structure +9, Incense -3. New parameters Range Scent, Duration Censer, Regrowth and Perpetual, Target Incense and Incensed. Spells above 18 Warp their targets. No enchanting, but Perpetual spells make simple items. Cinnabar longevity: Cinnabar Magic / 2 as a Longevity Ritual modifier (first claim a Warping Point and sterility, then 1 WP a year). Duels: opposed Com + Magic Ability reciting poems. No Magical Defenses are described. Myrrh descendants of jinniyah have Myrrh Blood (Faerie Sight; tier not given, not added). Soqotran hedge witches use Hedge Magic RE's rules.

training.notes: Childhood: native language 5 and 45 xp from the core list (often Arabic, then Soqotri). About 15 years' training: 240 xp and 72 spell levels. Each later year 30 points, spent 1 for 1 on Abilities or 3 spell levels per 5 points. The tribe's great spirit Opens the Gift (an Opening Total of 12, so Deficiencies are rare); there is no apprenticeship, the spirit allies teach. The free Puissant Virtue is +2 to casting in the chosen style.

casting.name: Soqotran spell
casting.fatigue: 1 Fatigue level whenever the total falls short, whether or not it works
casting.vis: extra sparks (tenths of a pawn) of essential incense, +1 each, at most the Ability score in sparks
casting.notes: Every spell needs an incense ceremony and at least one spark. Perfunctory: the same round, a spark, +0. Minor (15 minutes, a spark and common incense) and full (15 minutes, a spark per 3 EF and the spirit ally present) add Artes Liberales; EF 30+ needs a full ceremony. Ceremony vis adds nothing; extra sparks add a botch die (sparks / 10 if over 10). A spirit ally's Might Pool adds +1 a point (ally up to the Ability, aide twice it), own tribe only; Serapis's Might +1 a point for council members. Take the best bonus of each kind. Penetration is assumed Hermetic (Casting Total - level + Penetration). No spontaneous spells.
casting.botch_notes: +1 for extra sparks of vis, or sparks / 10 (rounded up) above 10 (RM p. 115)

advancement.notes: Practice or training only: no books and no vis study. Spells are learned from a teacher, levels gained each season until they reach the EF: a sorcerer teaches Com + his Ability + his Sources of Power - EF; a spirit Com + 3 x Magic Ability + Teaching + aura + Might Pool points - EF (whose Com and Ability is not stated). High-level and other tribes' spells cost favors.

activities.label: Learn a spell from a teacher
activities.summary: A season's teaching by a sorcerer or spirit adds levels toward a spell until they reach its EF.

bonds.name: Spirit ally
bonds.how: Bound through the tribe's training; a starting character has one with the Soqotran Sorcerer package and his tribe's Ability at 5+, else by a quest. The spirit has the Spirit Ally Virtue.
bonds.feeds: Its Might Pool adds +1 a point to his Casting Total in its tribe's magic, up to his Ability score; it teaches spells and guards him.
bonds.notes: Sample Might: Soqotran giant gecko 23 (Cinnabar), heron of light 31 (Aloe, not tree-bound), jinniyah 25 good or 15 evil (Myrrh, faerie), olibanum serpent 17, 25 or 33 (Olibanum). Most have Vulnerability (Tree). It shares an Arcane Connection with him.

bonds.name: Spirit aide
bonds.how: A closer bond offered for heroic deeds, reaching Ability 9, election as a council leader or a task for the King of the Olibanum Serpents (jinniyah offer it freely); Senior Soqotran Sorcerer.
bonds.feeds: Up to twice his Ability score in Might Pool points on one spell.

pools.name: Sparks of vis
pools.income: 120 sparks (12 pawns) a year from the tribe's tree; more may be borrowed from seniors, council leaders or spirits without a sorcerer.
pools.costs: At least 1 spark a spell; a full ceremony 1 per 3 EF; each extra spark +1 to the Casting Total.
pools.cap: Extra sparks on one spell: at most the Ability score.
pools.notes: A spark is a tenth of a pawn.

pools.name: Spirit's Might Pool
pools.income: The ally's Might (it recovers as the creature's Might does).
pools.costs: +1 to the Casting Total a point, or the same to dispel a spell its Might helped make.
pools.cap: Per spell: his Ability score (an aide: twice it).

pools.name: Might of Serapis
pools.income: Council of Tribes members: by lot 5 a day, elected or appointed 10 a day; Council of Three Birds 10 a day each. Serapis's pool is 65 and recovers in four hours.
pools.costs: +1 to the Casting Total a point.
pools.cap: The daily allowance; it cannot be combined with a magical-animal ally's Might on one spell (a Myrrh faerie ally's can).
pools.notes: A councillor by lot under 21 has no vote and no bonus.

warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points in one event.
warping.notes: Transformation Avoidance: Sta + Magic Ability + stress die vs Warping Score + WP gained + aura + stress die (no botch). Failure turns him into a tree of his tribe, not self-aware. His ally restores him the next spring by spending Might equal to the Warping Points gained, and he gains that many xp in his tribe's Ability.
