entries.name: Canaanite Necromancers
entries.description: The lost necromancers of Canaan and En-Dor, whose single Supernatural Ability reaches the dead wherever they are not in Heaven. Their ghosts and clay tablets survive, and a necromancer can help a magus integrate the art.
entries.notes: Any character with the Virtue can practise it. A Gifted character can learn from a ghost teacher (Magic Might 25, Canaanite Necromancy 5, Teaching 4), impractical for magi because their Arts lower the Source Quality. 'The dead' are those who died and are not in Heaven (Hell, Purgatory, deaths in faerie or magic realms, ghosts), not faeries, angels, demons, animals or magi in Final Twilight; one buried with Divine rites but not in Heaven is affected at double botch dice. As a lab assistant to a magus integrating the art, a necromancer adds Int + Canaanite Necromancy; the resulting Hermetic Virtue (Canaanite Magic) belongs to the breakthroughs.

casting.name: Necromancy
casting.notes: The EF is 3 x the duplicated effect's magnitude (an InCo 15 effect: EF 9). It may use the Veil of Death range. A botch: a demon of Might 10 impersonates the dead person. The Fatigue cost is not stated.
casting.botch_notes: doubled when the dead had a Divine burial (AM p. 33)

advancement.notes: Study, practice or teaching, as any Supernatural Ability. The En-Dor clay tablets are seven sequences of six, each an Area Lore (Canaan) summa (level 10, Quality 15; -3 per missing tablet).

entries.name: Defixio Cults
entries.description: The five ancient cults of the curse tablet, each tied to a Technique and Form: Ceres (Creo Mentem), Hecate (Perdo Corpus or Animal), Minerva (Rego Corpus or Animal), Pluto (Rego Mentem) and Proserpina (Muto Mentem). Their lore makes defixiones that strike a named target from afar.
entries.notes: The book offers Defixio Lore as an illustrative Ability rather than a full tradition; no training is given. Religious names (baptismal names, laqab, rabbinic names) cannot be used, and a spell using only one fails. A defixio is not an Arcane Connection and never raises the Penetration multiplier. Specialties: a cult. The Leadworker Virtue (HoH:TL) descends from it. Integrating it gives the Event Duration and Unlimited Range breakthroughs (not recorded here).

casting.name: Defixio
casting.vis: 1 pawn per magnitude of the cult's Technique or Form, spent in preparation
casting.notes: A day's preparation. EF = how the target is known (full name and Arcane Connection 0, full name 3, nickname 6, precise description 9, cannot be known 12) + 1 per magnitude of the effect (a Minor Supernatural Ability counts as magnitude 4, a Major one 7). Failure may be retried; a botch destroys the defixio. Both the Lore and the effect must penetrate; the Lore's Penetration is the roll - EF.

advancement.notes: As any Supernatural Ability.

entries.name: Heronic Mechanici
entries.description: Gifted followers of Heron of Alexandria who build mechanica: devices of natural philosophy, not enchantment, that simulate one Creo, Rego, Perdo or Muto effect on Auram, Aquam, Ignem, Mentem or Terram, and animae, mechanical simulacra of living creatures.
entries.notes: Gifted only, with a Virtue giving Academic Abilities. One effect per ordinary mechanica, nothing that would need vis, Range at most Voice, no vis used. Uses per day, Penetration and triggers follow the Hermetic enchantment rules, and auras apply as to devices. Texts: Automata (summa L4), Automaton Theatre (tractatus Q9), Metrica (tractatus Q10), Pneumatica (tractatus Q7), Mechanica (summa L3). Integrating it gives the Mutable Device and Awakened Device breakthroughs (not recorded here).

training.notes: The book gives no apprenticeship; the Virtue gives the Ability at 1.

casting.name: Construct Total
casting.notes: Adds the lower of Philosophiae and Artes Liberales, and the aura; it must exceed the Creation Level: 3 x magnitude + size (wagon or boat -3, easily carried +3, hand-sized +6) - 3 if it takes 15 minutes a magnitude to use, at least 3. One mechanica a season, 1 Mythic Pound per 3 Creation Levels; failure loses the season and half the materials. Inventive Genius and experimentation apply. Altering one (a week and a pound) adds a stress die against the new Creation Level, same Technique and Form, no higher level; a botch destroys it.

casting.name: Awaken Total
casting.notes: Adds the lower of Philosophiae and Artes Liberales, and the aura; it must exceed 9 + the anima's Might magnitude, +1 per extra season spent. An interruption ruins the work.

advancement.notes: As any Supernatural Ability; the surviving Greek texts are summae and tractatus on it.

activities.label: Construct a mechanica
activities.summary: A season building one device; the Construct Total must exceed its Creation Level.

activities.label: Build an anima
activities.summary: Seasons adding Mechanica of Heron + Int Might points to a simulacrum, at a pound per Might point.

activities.label: Awaken an anima
activities.summary: A season: the Awaken Total must exceed 9 + its Might magnitude.

bonds.name: Anima
bonds.how: Build its Might over seasons (Mechanica of Heron + Int a season), then awaken it: Int + Mechanica of Heron + lower of Philosophiae and Artes Liberales + aura must exceed 9 + its Might magnitude.
bonds.feeds: A tireless servant that can learn Abilities; often Loyal +3.
bonds.notes: Might = Size + material base + lower of Philosophiae and Artes Liberales; 1 pound per Might point. Trait points equal its Might magnitude (Int +0 if none spent there); moving and speaking are constant effects. It never tires and cannot be a familiar.

entries.name: Hyperborean Hymnists
entries.description: Reciters of the hymns Apollo taught the sun people of Hyperborea. Each hymn is a Supernatural Ability whose points hold Powers infused through seasons of contemplation, used at will with no roll; choirs sing one-off effects together, and relics hold Powers.
entries.notes: Only the Gifted, or holders of Hyperborean Hymnist, can recite a hymn; it is very hard for a Hermetic magus to learn one. Invoking an infused Power takes formulaic casting time and a spoken prayer (never silent), no gestures, no vis and no Rituals; at night 15 minutes per EF point. Effect modifiers as Hermetic; a constant or environmental trigger Warps. New Duration 19 Years (Year + 1 magnitude). Permanent effects are allowed. Magic Resistance comes from the Power Numina of Apollo (MR = level - 5), constant and so Warping. The Hymn score adds to Soak against its principles (only the highest hymn counts) and to relevant Lab Totals. Puissant (Hymn) raises totals and Soak but not Power levels. Choirs use Ceremony (the Magic-realm version; reuses vf_ceremony). Hyperborean is a Dead Language (Ancient Greek -4 understands it). Finding a hymn: Int + Magic Lore + stress die vs 21.

training.notes: No apprenticeship is given. Hyperborean Hymnist gives a Hymn at 1 with 15 levels of Powers already infused; more can be added at creation, but further Powers take seasons in play.

casting.name: Infuse a Power
casting.notes: A season of contemplation: Com + Hymn + modifiers + aura must reach EF = (total Power levels + modifiers) / 3, rounded up. Modifiers: devotional behaviour +3 a season (max +9), each day without reciting -1 (max -20), Hyperborean Descent +2 / +4, Dead Language: Hyperborean score, an honourable Personality Flaw +1 / +3, a dishonourable one -1 / -3. Once infused the Power is used at will with no roll. Improving a Power uses the difference in levels.

casting.name: Enchant a relic
casting.vis: none: 2 Warping Points per pawn that would be needed, opening included
casting.notes: Int + Hymn + modifiers + aura vs (levels + modifiers) / 3, one season per Power. No shape, material or size limits; Rituals allowed. No talismans, charged items, familiars, longevity effects (but Eternal Youth), Lab Texts, experimentation or Powers from two hymns.

casting.name: Choir
casting.vis: pawns equal to the final EF, of a Technique or Form fitting the effect
casting.notes: A one-off effect, not infused; at least a day (3 days +1, 7 +2, 14 +3, 21 +4, 28 +5). +5 levels per extra hymn; only the focus needs every hymn used. The book's example adds no die.

groups.notes: Each participant adds Com + the Hymn; a leader's Ceremony limits how many count, and without one the bonus takes -1 per participant. Seasonal work needs a leader; assistants gain Exposure xp.

advancement.notes: Each hymn is a Supernatural Ability, learned as usual (ArM5's rules for several Supernatural Abilities).

activities.summary: A season of contemplation infusing (or improving) one Power through a hymn.

activities.summary: A season putting one Power into a relic, paying Warping Points instead of vis.

pools.income: 15 levels of Powers per point of each Hymn.
pools.cap: About 150 levels per hymn in practice; each level beyond costs a pawn (or more, by troupe).
pools.notes: Puissant (Hymn) does not raise the levels; Affinity works normally.

warping.name: Illumination
warping.trigger: More than 2 Warping Points at once (not from enchanting), for a Gifted character whose main tradition is the hymns.
warping.notes: His Apollonian Personality Trait equals his Warping Score, and he has Dutybound (Minor). Roll Sta + Concentration + highest Hymn + stress die vs updated Warping Score + WP gained + aura + modifiers + stress die (Descent -2 / -4; +1 per 30 Power levels infused). Failure transforms him (crow, swan, bull, or his spirit leaves his body) for hours equal to the WP; to return, the same roll vs Warping Score + aura + modifiers, each failure a day and a cumulative -1. Bright Lightening: he may choose to fail, gaining Score + aura + modifiers extra Warping Points and as many xp in hymns. Not for magi.

guidelines.summary: rain: nourishing rain over 6 miles; Base 1, +1 Touch, +4 Year, +4 Bound, +1 size (errata p. 58)

guidelines.name: Bestow Fecundity (cost 35, Ease Factor 12)
guidelines.summary: fertility: a touched person or animal can conceive; Base 30, +1 Touch

guidelines.name: The Gift of Far-sighted Apollo (cost 25, Ease Factor 9)
guidelines.summary: sight: sees far as if near; Base 3, +2 Sun, +4 Vision

guidelines.name: Opening the Hidden Eyes (cost 40, Ease Factor 14)
guidelines.summary: auras: sees vis, auras, regiones and spirits; Base 5, +1 Conc, +4 Vision, +2 detail (errata p. 58)

guidelines.name: Cleansing Libation of the Sybil of Cumae (cost 55, Ease Factor 19)
guidelines.summary: disease: +12 to resist or recover from illness within a boundary; Base 5, +1 Touch, +5 19 Years, +4 Bound (the book prints Ease Factor 18)

guidelines.name: The Unseen Traveler (cost 15, Ease Factor 5)
guidelines.summary: secrecy: invisible but to Intellego and Second Sight; Base 4, +2 Sun, +1 changing image

guidelines.name: Turn to Lofty Heights (cost 35, Ease Factor 12)
guidelines.summary: intellect, spirits: his spirit leaves his body and travels; non-Hermetic

guidelines.name: Ride the Arrow of Abaris (cost 50, Ease Factor 17)
guidelines.summary: travel: instantly to any place he sees; Base 35, +3 Sight

guidelines.name: Punishment of Marsyas (cost 30, Ease Factor 10)
guidelines.summary: skin: flays a touched person, an Incapacitating Wound; Base 20, +1 Touch, +4 levels Penetration, 2/day

guidelines.name: Radiant Mantle of the Night-Wanderer (cost 45, Ease Factor 15)
guidelines.summary: skin, flesh: a travelling spirit takes on pseudo-flesh; non-Hermetic

guidelines.name: Fortitude of Cadmus (cost 15, Ease Factor 5)
guidelines.summary: stamina: +1 to Soak or to resist Fatigue; Base 5, +2 Sun

guidelines.name: Victory of the Lapiths (cost 15, Ease Factor 5)
guidelines.summary: stamina, conflict: wounds and Fatigue have no penalty until it ends; Base 10, +1 Diam

guidelines.name: Courage of the Python Slayer (cost 25, Ease Factor 9)
guidelines.summary: aggression: courage that a weaker fear effect can't break; Base 4, +2 Voice, +2 Sun, Pen +2, 12/day

guidelines.name: Slaying of Niobe's Children (cost 35, Ease Factor 12)
guidelines.summary: conflict, fever: unseen bolts of a Heavy Wound disease; Base 20, +2 Voice, Pen +4, 6/day

guidelines.name: Eternal Youth of the Sun (cost 65, Ease Factor 22)
guidelines.summary: youth: ignores aging, crises too, a Warping Point a year; Base 40, +5 19 Years

guidelines.name: Thalia's Relief (cost 15, Ease Factor 5)
guidelines.summary: optimism: relieves worry and grief; Base 4, +1 Touch, +2 Sun

guidelines.name: Divination of True Intent (cost 25, Ease Factor 9)
guidelines.summary: justice: the truth of one action or thought; Base 15, +1 Eye, Pen +4, 6/day

guidelines.name: Numina of Apollo (Magic Resistance)
guidelines.summary: any hymn: a Vim Power (R: Per, D: Sun, T: Ind, Pen +0, 1/day) giving Magic Resistance (level - 5) against effects of its principles; Base General, +1 Sun; a constant one Warps

entries.guideline_source: Ancient Magic pp. 107-114, errata p. 58: Powers take the Hermetic guidelines within the hymn's principles; the level typed is the Power's level cost

entries.name: Storm Wizards
entries.description: A handful of solitary, Gifted hermits of the Transylvanian peaks, said to be carried off as babies by giants, who raise, steer, ride and fight with storms. They harvest unmelting magical ice (Auram vis) from mountain sites and end their training by killing a giant and eating its heart.
entries.notes: Always Gifted and almost always men. The three storm powers come at 0 when the Gift is Opened, so a storm wizard does not buy their Virtues (other characters may, at 1). Giant Blood is free at creation; it is earned by the Heart of the Storm initiation that ends apprenticeship, but the full powers work from the Opening. A storm power's magnitude is its score (for Warping or dispelling). Penetration is the roll minus the Ease Factor plus the Hermetic Penetration bonus. When two wizards contest a storm, the highest roll that meets the Ease Factor wins and there is no cooperation. The book prints no apprenticeship length or xp and no Magical Defenses.

training.notes: The book gives no apprenticeship xp: use the usual Gifted-companion creation. Giant Blood is free at creation, gained at the apprenticeship's end by the Heart of the Storm initiation.

casting.name: Storm Calling
casting.vis: Auram (any kind) spent to create a storm: 1 pawn Local, 2 Provincial, 4 National; it is a cost, not a bonus; moving a storm needs none
casting.notes: Creating: Ease Factor = size (Local +3, Provincial +6, National +12) + duration (Diameter +3, Hour +6, Sun +9, Moon +12); the storm takes that many rounds to form, centred where he stood. Moving: Ease Factor = size only, about a mile per Diameter, a new roll each Diameter, and he must see it. A created storm is natural: it needs no Penetration and enters an Aegis freely.

casting.name: Storm Riding
casting.notes: He must see the storm; +3 if he is inside it. Ease Factor 9: sense from any point in it while concentrating (his senses must penetrate Magic Resistance); 12: move himself instantly to any point in it; 15: send a touched person there (must penetrate; falling damage from height).

casting.name: Storm Fighting
casting.notes: He must see the storm and a target inside it; Initiative 0. Buffet: the roll is a melee Attack Total, as many a round as his score, +10 damage, no effect on anyone with Magic Resistance. Deluge EF 3: everyone within 30 yards rolls Dex vs 6 or falls. Hail EF 6: +3 damage to all within 30 yards. Deluge and Hail ignore Magic Resistance. Erosion EF 9: one structure collapses. Lightning EF 12: one target, +20 damage, cannot miss, must penetrate.

casting.name: Ice harvesting
casting.notes: A season at a mountain site with a Magic aura: (Int + Organization Lore: Storm Wizards + Magic aura) / 3, rounded UP, is the pawns of Auram vis (unmelting ice) gathered. The app rounds down; add 1 when there is a remainder.

opening.notes: Opening Total: the master's Intelligence + Organization Lore: Storm Wizards.

initiation.notes: Performed at the end of apprenticeship; it marks a full storm wizard, as the gauntlet does a magus. The book prints only this script.

scripts.name: Heart of the Storm
scripts.notes: Quest +3 (hunt a true giant and eat its heart), Major Ordeal +9, sympathetic bonus +3. Finding the giant and an Arcane Connection to it can take several seasons.

advancement.notes: His powers are Supernatural Abilities on the Ability table, advanced like any Ability.

activities.label: Harvest magical ice
activities.summary: A season's ritual at a secret mountain site with a Magic aura, gathering unmelting ice that is Auram vis.

warping.name: Storm Trance
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points from one event, or reaching a new Warping Score.
warping.notes: Strength + stress die vs 3 + Warping Score. On a failure he becomes a Local storm for a Moon, unable to use his powers but able to speak through the wind. Once a day he may roll again to re-form his body at a point he chooses in the storm. If the storm ends first he seems to die or passes into the Magic Realm. The storm is natural and cannot be dispelled, but destroying it by magic (Perdo Auram) kills him.

entries.name: Hunters
entries.description: Balkan vampire hunters marked by birth (sabotnici, glogove) or by a vampire parent (dhampiri, vampirdzhia), who hold scraps of the old taltós Hunters' Arts: Scry to track a foe, Ban to ward against it and Slay to kill it, each worked only against a Foe Art they know. They need not be Gifted and learn the Arts as Virtues, with no master to Open them.
entries.notes: Each Practice Art (Scry, Ban, Slay) is a Major Supernatural Virtue and each Foe Art a Minor one; the first Practice Art bought brings one Foe Art free (most often Vampire), later ones do not. All are Difficult Arts on the Ability table, starting at 0. A Practice Art works only against a foe whose Foe Art he has; most hunters never learn another Foe Art. Against a mortal foe (a human or creature with Supernatural Abilities or Arts of a realm but no Might) every level is 10 higher. Penetration Total = Art Total + Penetration bonus - level, the bonus as a magus's. Suggested builds: sabotnici and glogove take Second Sight (maybe Magic Sensitivity); sabotnici usually Scry, glogove Ban or Slay; a female sabotnik may have Dream Interpretation; dhampiri and vampirdzhia take Dhampir (vf_dhampir) and usually Slay. Faerie Lore and Penetration help every hunter. Any Foe Art pairs with any Practice Art (Against the Dark p. 132): a hunter's totals use every Foe Art he holds, those listed here or another the troupe names (Foe: Dragon).

training.notes: No tradition training: a hunter is a normal character who buys the Practice and Foe Arts as Virtues (the first Practice Art brings one Foe Art free).

casting.name: Scry
casting.notes: One round, touching or seeing the foe or touching an Arcane Connection to it; must penetrate. Level 3 direction and distance; 4 smell and muffled sound; 5 all it hears and foggy sight (+1 sympathetic bonus); 10 sight and sound within 5 paces (+2). Levels assume Touch: Sight +1 magnitude, Arcane +2. Mortal foes +10. A botch gives the foe the connection instead. One connection at a time; using it is Sta + Concentration + stress die vs 6 + Might/5, not magical. The sympathetic bonus adds to every Penetration against that foe.

casting.name: Physical Ban
casting.notes: An amulet made over 12 hours, lasting Sun once put on and expiring 3 days after it is made. Level 5 (15 against a mortal foe); Ban Strength = total - level. It absorbs each wound the foe deals while Strength is above 0, then loses 3/5/10/15/20 for a Light/Medium/Heavy/Incapacitating/Deadly wound. One Physical and one Supernatural Ban at a time.

casting.name: Supernatural Ban
casting.notes: An amulet as the Physical Ban. Level chosen (+10 against a mortal foe's powers): 10 cuts the first matching power's duration by a quarter (or forces an extra Concentration roll), 15 by half (+3 Ease Factor), 20 by three quarters (+6). Works once; need not penetrate the foe's Might, but worn by someone with Magic Resistance it works only if it penetrates his Vim resistance.

casting.name: Weakening Ban
casting.notes: An area ringed by at least 4 black hawthorn stakes (15 minutes each, at most 50 paces apart; at least diameter in paces / 16, rounded up), active 3 days. The level is the Might it suppresses; it must penetrate. A foe inside has its Might Score cut by the level and loses Might points above the new score for good.

casting.name: Slay
casting.fatigue: 1 long-term Fatigue level
casting.notes: 24 hours charging a new weapon of at least standard quality (Dex + Craft workshop total 6+); the aura is where it is made. Level 25 (35 against a mortal foe), -5 for each true fact about the foe used (not below 5, or 15 for a mortal foe), +5 for each false one; the storyguide keeps the level secret. A hit that beats Defense and penetrates gives the foe an Incapacitating Wound; the weapon is then inert for ever.

advancement.notes: Exposure, Adventure, Practice, Teaching and Books (few exist, most written by Hermetic hunters). Difficult Arts: the Ability table.

guidelines.name: Direction and distance
guidelines.summary: Know the foe's direction and distance; no sympathetic bonus

guidelines.name: Smell and muffled sound
guidelines.summary: Smell what the foe smells, hear muffled sounds

guidelines.name: Hear and vague sight
guidelines.summary: Hear all the foe hears, foggy view; +1 sympathetic

guidelines.name: See and hear nearby
guidelines.summary: See and hear within five paces of foe; +2 sympathetic

entries.guideline_source: Against the Dark p. 134; levels at Touch; against a mortal foe every level is 10 higher (two further magnitudes)

entries.name: Fectores
entries.description: Gifted hunters trained at the Tremere oppidum of Laniena, who are Opened to all three Hunters' Arts (Scry, Ban, Slay) and three Foe Arts, and serve House Tremere's war on supernatural foes, usually as Gifted companions of House Ex Miscellanea.
entries.notes: A Fector takes the place of a magus. He has all three Practice Arts and chooses three Foe Arts from those Laniena teaches (Vampire, Werewolf, Ghost, Nightwalker, Witch); Second Sight is free. He may take Martial and Arcane Abilities and Latin at creation, other Academic Abilities only with a Virtue. Fectores have no Magical Defenses except their Ban amulets; those in the Order may learn Parma Magica. The Arts work as for every hunter (see Hunters): Difficult, Ability table, +10 levels against mortal foes, Penetration as a magus's. Laniena's initiation scripts can Open the Arts for a Gifted student or teach a new Foe Art, but none teach a single Practice Art, so there are no unGifted Fectores; the scripts are not printed.

training.notes: About five years from adolescence under a Fector: 120 xp on the Hunters' Arts or Abilities (Martial, Arcane and Latin allowed; other Academic Abilities need a Virtue). The Opening also gives three Foe Arts of the student's choice at 0.

casting.name: Scry
casting.notes: As for Hunters: level 3 to 10 by the strength of the connection, +10 against a mortal foe; must penetrate.

casting.name: Physical Ban
casting.notes: As for Hunters: level 5 (15 against a mortal foe); the excess is the Ban Strength that absorbs the foe's wounds.

casting.name: Supernatural Ban
casting.notes: As for Hunters: level 10, 15 or 20 cuts the foe's first matching power.

casting.name: Weakening Ban
casting.notes: As for Hunters: hawthorn stakes ring an area for 3 days; the level is the Might suppressed; must penetrate.

casting.name: Slay
casting.fatigue: 1 long-term Fatigue level
casting.notes: As for Hunters: level 25 (35 against a mortal foe), -5 per true fact, +5 per false one; a penetrating hit gives an Incapacitating Wound.

opening.notes: Opening Total: the master's Intelligence + Scry. It opens Scry, Ban, Slay and three Foe Arts at 0.

advancement.notes: Exposure, Adventure, Practice, Teaching and Books. Difficult Arts: the Ability table.

guidelines.name: Direction and distance
guidelines.summary: Know the foe's direction and distance; no sympathetic bonus

guidelines.name: Smell and muffled sound
guidelines.summary: Smell what the foe smells, hear muffled sounds

guidelines.name: Hear and vague sight
guidelines.summary: Hear all the foe hears, foggy view; +1 sympathetic

guidelines.name: See and hear nearby
guidelines.summary: See and hear within five paces of foe; +2 sympathetic

entries.guideline_source: Against the Dark p. 134; levels at Touch; against a mortal foe every level is 10 higher (two further magnitudes)

entries.name: Franciscans
entries.description: The Little Brothers and Poor Sisters who follow Francis of Assisi in poverty, preaching and service. A few, guided by more experienced Franciscans, grow holy powers; outsiders may see a Holy Tradition, though no Franciscan would call it one.
entries.notes: Open only to a character who lives as a Franciscan friar or joins the Poor Sisters (The Church p. 137). Made at creation, the Supernatural Virtues for the favored Abilities are balanced by Flaws as usual, Monastic Vows is compulsory, and the book suggests Flaws from the Scripts (p. 138). Every Script needs a Mystagogue who knows the Virtue. Two need a season in Francis' cave near Assisi: one living nearby may find it taken and have to wait. Francis, guided by angels, suits a Script to each candidate, so his first followers have other Flaws or several of these Virtues; after his death (1226 in history) other Mystagogues may unknowingly use an unsuitable Script (p. 139). The book's Franciscan Lore is the Organization Lore here.

training.notes: The book gives no apprenticeship: build the member as a normal character, buying the tradition's Methods and Powers as Major Supernatural Virtues (Ability 1). With True Faith they may also be learned by study. Traditions teach Dominion Lore, Finesse and Penetration besides.

casting.name: Holy Method and Power
casting.fatigue: Purity: a long-term Fatigue level or a Light Wound each use. Meditation: a Stamina roll against 6 every ten minutes, a Fatigue level on a failure.
casting.vis: none: holy effects use no vis
casting.notes: Characteristic + Method + Power + aura + a simple die against the level (Invocation costs a Confidence or Faith Point and may roll a stress die). Ranges, Durations and Targets as Hermetic magic; what would need a Ritual, Boundary, Year or permanent adds 20 to the level. A shortfall brings a tragedy of hubris: Minor (1-10 short), Major (11-20) or Ultimate (21+); True Faith x 10 may stand in for the total when judging it. Any Method may be repeated as an extended ritual to spend more Confidence before the roll.

advancement.notes: Methods and Powers are Supernatural Abilities. With True Faith a member learns his one tradition's favored Abilities without subtracting his Supernatural Abilities from the Advancement Total; others learn the rest with that penalty. Without True Faith he gets favored Abilities only as Virtues at creation (or, perhaps, by initiation).

warping.name: Divine Ascent
warping.trigger: 2 or more Warping Points from one event.
warping.notes: Avoid it: Presence + Concentration (or Meditation) + stress die against Warping Score + Warping Points gained + True Faith + aura + stress die. A failure adds Warping Points equal to the margin and an Ascent of max(1, Warping Score + points gained - True Faith) days (months from Warping Score 6). At the first Ascent the character picks Divine Gloom, Divine Form or Divine Unity for life. There is no Final Ascent.

initiation.notes: Each Script names the Presence + Franciscan Lore it needs (its Initiation Total less its bonus). The printed totals count the earlier Scripts' Ordeals: Understanding, Intervention and Purity are written for an Initiate who has already suffered Meditation's Major Ordeal (21 - 9, - 6, - 3); the app takes those reductions off itself (The Church pp. 138-139).

scripts.name: Meditation
scripts.notes: A season alone in Francis' cave above Assisi, the Mystagogue guiding the first week: Major Ordeal +9, Quest +3, the founder's path (sympathy) +3. Needs Presence + Lore 6.

scripts.name: Understanding
scripts.notes: A Quest for a Byzantine crucifix 200 years old, won without sin or owning it, then days of prayer before it in St Damian's chapel and an intense vision: Minor Ordeal +3, Quest +3, sympathy +1. Printed for a Target of 12 (after Meditation's Ordeal); needs Presence + Lore 5. One unworthy, unconfessed or with the Quest unfulfilled, gains Plagued by Supernatural Entity instead.

scripts.name: Intervention
scripts.notes: From the autumn equinox to midwinter with the Mystagogue, then alone in rags through the winter snows to work as a scullion till the spring equinox, then to Rome for a papal blessing never asked for: time and place +1, the Initiate's time +1, the Mystagogue's time +3, Quest +3, sympathy +1. Printed for a Target of 15; needs Presence + Lore 6.

scripts.name: Purity
scripts.notes: A season in Francis' cave in rags on less food than the friars nearby: Quest +3, Minor Ordeal +3, sympathy +3. Printed for a Target of 18; needs Presence + Lore 9.

entries.name: Cult of Mercury
entries.description: What is left of the old Roman Cult of Mercury, centred on Aedes Mercurii in Provence: pagan priests of the Order, guarding the old rites and the lost secrets of Mercurian ritual magic, at odds with the Neo-Mercurians and the Mithraians alike.
abilities: Mystery Cult Lore: Cult of Mercury
entries.notes: Its flamens speak for the gods at each day of the Provençal Tribunal. Isolationist: magi have no business in mundane affairs. A few members cast non-Hermetic Mercurian rituals (Houses of Hermes: True Lineages pp. 76-77). Faith & Flame pp. 28-29.

training.notes: A Hermetic Mystery Cult: its members are magi, initiated into its Virtues in play or chosen as Hermetic Virtues at creation.

advancement.notes: Members advance as magi; the cult Lore is an ordinary Ability.

initiation.lore: Mystery Cult Lore: Cult of Mercury
initiation.notes: Faith & Flame p. 28.

scripts.name: Consecration of Priamitus
scripts.notes: A season on the old Roman roads with the Mystagogue (+3); the rite at an old Temple of Mercury such as Aedes Mercurii on 15 May, the Mercuralia (+3); water won from the spirit of the Mercurian well in a Magic regio at Porta Capena on the Appian Way (Quest +3); forswearing the old faith for Rome's gods, taking Pagan (+9). The Mystagogue knows the Virtue.

entries.name: Legion of Mithras
entries.description: Heroic defenders of the Order, many of them Hoplites, keeping a Christianised Mithraic mystery: loyalty, bravery, honesty and duty, in ranks under a quasi-military command.
abilities: Mystery Cult Lore: Legion of Mithras
entries.notes: Ranks and what each is usually taught (The Mysteries Revised Edition pp. 120-122): Raven (an oath that is a Minor Ordeal, Dutybound (Legion of Mithras); then Strong-Willed); Bride (a Quest; Clear Thinker); Soldier (a heroic Quest; Reserves of Strength or Enduring Constitution); Lion (Quests commanding Soldiers; Inscription on the Soul; seven years at the temple, worth +5 to the next Initiation); Persian (sacrifices the talisman; spirit familiars). Auxiliaries (grogs and companions) serve the temples. Strong in Provence at Castra Solis, mostly Christian Flambeau (Faith & Flame pp. 27-28).

training.notes: A Hermetic Mystery Cult: its members are magi, initiated into its Virtues in play or chosen as Hermetic Virtues at creation.

advancement.notes: Members advance as magi; the cult Lore is an ordinary Ability.

initiation.lore: Mystery Cult Lore: Legion of Mithras
initiation.notes: Raven Mystagogues are usually Lions with the Lore 6+ and Presence +1. The cult keeps harder Scripts for weaker Mystagogues, but seldom uses one under +5 (p. 121).

scripts.name: Raven: Strong-Willed
scripts.notes: A journey to deliver a message to a Legionnaire deep among the Order's enemies, never betraying the Legion (Quest +3), a season of exercises of the will with the Auxiliaries (service +1, and exposure in the Lore), sympathy +1. Usually after the Raven's oath (Dutybound, a Minor Ordeal), so its Target is 12.

entries.name: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.description: Magi who live as knights errant and minnesingers, questing for the Stone of Creation that fell from Heaven: poets, lovers and chivalrous warriors, most of them Jerbiton and Tytalus.
entries.notes: Members play knights (the Knight status Virtue free, but they find their own horse and arms) and may swear to no mundane lord; women pass as men on the quest. Degrees, three Initiations each, a member may move up and forsake the rest (The Mysteries Revised Edition p. 132): Page (Free Expression, Performance Magic: Music, Art of Memory); Squire (Vulgar Alchemy, Hermetic Numerology, Consummate Talisman); Knight (Planetary Magic, Major Magical Focus or Potent Magic: Gemstones, Hermetic True Names). Most make their shield their talisman. A chapter in Provence at the Ostal des Exiles (Faith & Flame p. 29).

training.notes: A Hermetic Mystery Cult: its members are magi, initiated into its Virtues in play or chosen as Hermetic Virtues at creation.

advancement.notes: Members advance as magi; the cult Lore is an ordinary Ability.

initiation.notes: The Mystagogue is usually a Squire with the Lore 4+ and a positive Presence.

scripts.name: Page: Free Expression
scripts.ordeal: Dutybound (Minor): chivalry and the Order's rules
scripts.notes: Find the Knights' castle with Parzival as a guide and present oneself there at Pentecost (Quest +3); the oaths are the Minor Ordeal (+3); the cost of a knight's outfit (+1). The Initiate must also have Music 1. The book says the Ordeal lowers this Initiation's Target to 12; the Definitive Edition lowers only later ones (DE p. 388), so the app leaves it at 15.

entries.name: Matres et Matrones
entries.description: A Mystery Cult for the advancement of women, rooted in the folk witches of south-western France, the cult of Mary Magdalene and the Black Madonna, and the memory of Eleanor of Aquitaine; the Praeco Dama of Merinita is said to lead it.
entries.notes: Obscure, not secret. Hedge wizards and unGifted women with supernatural abilities are members too. Three levels, each after much service to the cult and the community (Faith & Flame p. 30). Sisters need the Lore 1 and swear to protect other women: Venus' Blessing, The Feminine Gift or the Gentle Gift. Mothers need the Lore 3 and a child borne or an apprentice taken: Good Teacher or Feminine Sympathy (Minor or Major), and grow Driven. Matrons need the Lore 6, Feminine Sympathy +3, a child or apprentice raised to maturity, and to be past menopause: Intuition, Dark Magic or Chthonic Magic. The book prints no Scripts: type the Script's bonus on the Initiation.

training.notes: Women only. Gifted members are magae of the Order; unGifted women with supernatural abilities join for its ceremonies and organisation.

advancement.notes: Members advance as magi; the cult Lore is an ordinary Ability.

initiation.notes: Faith & Flame p. 30: each level's prerequisites are in the notes.

entries.name: House Verditius (Mystery Cult)
entries.description: The Mystery Cult of House Verditius: four Minor and four Major Inner Mysteries, learned in any order from a fellow of the House, each Script sacrificing items and time, and Hubris growing with every one.
entries.notes: Every magus with Verditius Magic is a member. The House's Script components (Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p. 117): a Forge of Hephaestus or special place and time +3; a specific Quest for a lost Verditius item +3, a unique Quest for a legendary one +6; a Minor Ordeal +3, a Major +9; the Initiate's time serving the House +1 (once); sacrificing a lesser enchanted item of the 4th magnitude +3, a greater of the 7th or his talisman +6; the Mystagogue's time +3; the Mystagogue's wealth, a Mythic Pound per point of the Initiate's Hubris, +1 (once); the Outer Mystery given as the Arts are opened +6. The Initiate needs the Lore 3 for a Minor Inner Mystery and 5 for a Major (p. 118); the first always brings Hubris. Its Ordeals, each once (pp. 120-121): Sever the Ties that Bind (not for the Primus's line), self-mutilation (Lame, Hobbled or Crippled), Prone to Chance or Averse to Risk (not both), Increased Hubris. A magus who never acts as Mystagogue gets the House Reputation Selfish 4. Confraternities (pp. 121-123) follow set paths of Mysteries.

training.notes: The Outer Mystery, Verditius Magic, is given as the apprentice's Arts are opened, by a master with Presence + the Lore 3 (and the Lore 2 to open Arts at once): no Lore is needed of the apprentice (p. 118).

advancement.notes: Members advance as magi; Verditius Cult Lore is an Arcane Ability, most often trained by a fellow with it at 2 or more (p. 117).

initiation.notes: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults pp. 117-135; the Definitive Edition pp. 240-243 reprints the Outer Mystery, Hubris and Enchant Casting Tools and wins where they differ. The sample Scripts use the usual Targets, lower after an Ordeal.

scripts.name: Outer Mystery: Verditius Magic
components: Special place: a Forge of Hephaestus
The Initiate's time: a season of service
The Mystagogue's time
The Mystagogue's wealth cast into the forge
The Outer Mystery given as the Arts are opened
scripts.notes: A season of slavish service as the apprentice's Arts are opened, then a journey to a Forge of Hephaestus (Verdi, Lemnos or Mount Olympus), where the master casts money and jewels into the forge: special place, the Initiate's and the Mystagogue's time, wealth, Arts opened at once (+12). The Mystagogue needs Presence + Lore 3 (p. 118).

scripts.name: Enchant Casting Tools
components: The Mystagogue's time: a season making casting tools
Her casting tools buried in a Magic regio on an anniversary
Minor Ordeal
scripts.ordeal: Hubris if it is the first Inner Mystery, else Limited Magic Resistance (Vim) (Minor)
scripts.notes: The Mystagogue spends a season with the Initiate making casting tools (+3); on an anniversary of the Outer Mystery the Initiate buries all her casting tools in a Magic regio (+3); the Ordeal (+3). DE p. 243 (HoH:MC p. 124 gives Limited Magic Resistance either way; the DE wins).

scripts.name: Items of Quality
components: The journey to a Forge of Hephaestus
The magic item and its mundane twin sacrificed on the forge
Minor Ordeal: Increased Hubris
scripts.notes: A season enchanting a magic item and making a mundane twin, then both sacrificed at a Forge of Hephaestus (+3, +3); the Ordeal (+3) (p. 125).

scripts.name: Reforging Enchanted Items
components: The Initiate's time: a season making identical items
The Mystagogue's time: a season assisting
Minor Ordeal: Averse to Risk
scripts.notes: A season making as many identical items as the Craft allows (+1), burned by the Mystagogue, who sacrifices the season assisting (+3); the Ordeal (+3) (p. 127).

scripts.name: Verditius Elder Runes
components: The journey to Durenmar (a season)
A greater enchanted item burned in Verditius's forge
scripts.notes: A season's journey to Durenmar (+3); on the winter solstice the Initiate burns a greater enchanted item in Verditius's forge (+6) and eats a crow roasted over it (p. 128).

scripts.name: Automata
components: The Initiate's time: a season studying an automaton of Hephaestus
Quest: a brand from the lighthouse of Alexandria, kept lit
Major Ordeal: Necessary Condition
scripts.ordeal: Necessary Condition: near an open flame to work magic (Major Ordeal)
scripts.notes: A season studying one of Hephaestus's automata (+1); a brand stolen from the lighthouse of Alexandria and kept lit to the Mystagogue (+3); the Ordeal (+9) (p. 131).

scripts.name: Bind Curse
components: Unique Quest: an item made by Hephaestus or a pagan smith-god
The Mystagogue's time: investigating it together
Minor Ordeal: Hatred for Seekers
scripts.notes: A unique item made by Hephaestus or another pagan god's smith found (+6) and investigated with the Mystagogue (+3); the Ordeal (+3) (pp. 133-134).

scripts.name: Bind Magical Creatures
components: Quest: the body of a magical creature she didn't kill
The Initiate's time: a season of Greek funeral rites
The urn made of its ashes sacrificed
Wealth sacrificed at a mock funeral
scripts.notes: A magical creature's body found, whose death the Initiate did not cause (+3); a season of Greek funeral rites (+1); an urn of its ashes with powers like its own, sacrificed (+3) with much wealth (+1) (p. 135).

scripts.name: Item Attunement
components: Initiating another Verditius into a Minor Inner Mystery
The Initiate's time: a season serving the Mystagogue
His talisman sacrificed on a solstice
scripts.notes: The Initiate makes a talisman, then initiates another Verditius into a Minor Inner Mystery he knows (+3), serves the Mystagogue a season with the talisman's powers (+1), and sacrifices it on a solstice (+6) (p. 135).

scripts.name: Confraternity of Roland: Minor Magical Focus (Swords)
components: Quest: Durendal stolen from its keeper
Quest: the Creed recited a hundred times in an Infernal regio
Quest: an enemy slain in battle bearing it
Special place and time: Roncesvals on Roland's anniversary
scripts.notes: Durendal stolen from its keeper (+3); the Creed recited a hundred times in an Infernal regio (+3); an enemy slain in battle bearing it (+3); a catatonic peril at Roncesvals on Roland's anniversary (+3). Its path: Reforging, Items of Quality, Elder Runes, Item Attunement (p. 121).

scripts.name: Confraternity of Balento: Bind Magical Creatures
components: Special place and time: the Tiber at the Vulcanalia
Quest: five fish from a Magic aura
Quest: five fish from a Faerie aura
His talisman and a pint of blood sacrificed
scripts.notes: Ten fish sacrificed on a floating fire on the Tiber at the Vulcanalia (+3), five each from a Magic and a Faerie aura (two Quests, +6); the talisman and a pint of blood sacrificed (+6). Members have Affinity with Ignem and Deficient Form (Aquam) (p. 122).

scripts.name: Confraternity of Irene: Puissant Imaginem or Mentem
components: Quest: basalt cooled with holy water, or Carpathian pigments
Special place: the fume-filled cave off Tunisia
Minor Ordeal: Slow Caster
scripts.notes: Basalt cooled with holy water, or pigments from the Carpathian peaks (+3); a portrait of the patron saint made in darkness in a fume-filled cave off Tunisia (+3); the Ordeal (+3) (p. 122).

scripts.name: Confraternity of Himinis: Bind Curse
components: Quest: a thief's left hand taken alone under a full moon
The Initiate's time: a season serving the Mystagogue
Major Ordeal: Sever the Ties that Bind
scripts.ordeal: Sever the Ties that Bind (Major Ordeal)
scripts.notes: A thief's left hand taken alone under a full moon (+3), pickled while the Initiate serves the Mystagogue a season (+1), then burned and its fumes breathed; the Ordeal (+9). Members have Minor Magical Focus (Wooden Wands) and Envious (pp. 122-123).

entries.name: Clesrada
entries.description: The feats of arms of the Ulster heroes, part weapon-play, part juggling, part magic, taught by Scáthach and now only by her daughter Úathach at the Mercere House of Leth Cuinn. Each cles is a Faerie power gained by its own Initiation, and any warrior, Gifted or not, may learn them.
entries.notes: Record each cles known as a power on the Feat roll of its Characteristic, naming its Ability and its guideline (its Ease Factor). A Single Weapon cles may be learned with Great Weapon instead, chosen at Initiation. Úathach is the only Mystagogue and lays a geas on every Initiate never to Initiate another (losing every cles if broken). Breaking a cles's own geas loses that cles. The troupe may design more clesa; each targets its user.

training.notes: No apprenticeship: each cles is Initiated in play (The Contested Isle p. 101).

casting.name: Feat roll (Strength)
casting.notes: A cles that rolls Strength (TCI pp. 101-104). It counts as a 15th-level spell with Penetration 0 + the Penetration bonus against magic that affects spells, but acts on the user and need not penetrate a foe. Clesa of one Ability chain in one action, each rolled in turn until one fails, with no Attack that round.
casting.botch_notes: a botch always costs a Fatigue level (TCI p. 101)

casting.name: Feat roll (Stamina)
casting.notes: A cles that rolls Stamina (TCI pp. 101-104). It counts as a 15th-level spell with Penetration 0 + the Penetration bonus against magic that affects spells, but acts on the user and need not penetrate a foe. Clesa of one Ability chain in one action, each rolled in turn until one fails, with no Attack that round.
casting.botch_notes: a botch always costs a Fatigue level (TCI p. 101)

casting.name: Feat roll (Dexterity)
casting.notes: A cles that rolls Dexterity (TCI pp. 101-104). It counts as a 15th-level spell with Penetration 0 + the Penetration bonus against magic that affects spells, but acts on the user and need not penetrate a foe. Clesa of one Ability chain in one action, each rolled in turn until one fails, with no Attack that round.
casting.botch_notes: a botch always costs a Fatigue level (TCI p. 101)

casting.name: Feat roll (Quickness)
casting.notes: A cles that rolls Quickness (TCI pp. 101-104). It counts as a 15th-level spell with Penetration 0 + the Penetration bonus against magic that affects spells, but acts on the user and need not penetrate a foe. Clesa of one Ability chain in one action, each rolled in turn until one fails, with no Attack that round.
casting.botch_notes: a botch always costs a Fatigue level (TCI p. 101)

initiation.notes: Every cles has Ease Factor 15. Each Script is a quest tied in symbol to the feat and a geas (the Prohibition Flaw) as its Ordeal, with no bonus for an earlier Ordeal, so the unGifted may be Initiated (TCI p. 101; HMRE p. 14). Úathach's Presence + Organization Lore: Clesrada is 12.

scripts.name: Ubullchless by Quest and Ordeal
scripts.notes: Leave Leth Cuinn with an apple pip; within a year and a day bring back an enchanted apple freely given by the supernatural creature that owned it (+3); accept the geas Úathach whispers (+3).

advancement.notes: The clesa use ordinary Abilities; a new cles comes only by Initiation.

guidelines.name: Baí Brasse (Profit of Speed)
guidelines.summary: Qui + Athletics: hurry at 3x and run at 6x walking pace for a round

guidelines.name: Cless Caitt (Cat Feat)
guidelines.summary: Dex + Athletics: standing long jump of (8 - Encumbrance) x one's height

guidelines.name: Ích-n-Erred (Hero's Salmon Leap)
guidelines.summary: Str + Athletics: standing high jump of (4 - half Encumbrance, rounded up) x one's height

guidelines.name: Ochtarchless (Eight-Men Feat)
guidelines.summary: Sta + Athletics: +5 Strength to lift or hold a weight, while the rolls keep succeeding

guidelines.name: Rothchless (Wheel Feat)
guidelines.summary: Str + Athletics: hurl what one couldn't throw; a Thrown Weapon attack with damage = its Load

guidelines.name: Tétchless (Rope Feat)
guidelines.summary: Dex + Athletics: balance on anything smaller than a foot; +3 unstable, +3 moving, +3/+6 sloped; softens falls; Perfect Balance +6

guidelines.name: Cless For Análaib (Breath Feat)
guidelines.summary: Sta + Concentration: Deprivation rolls for air every five minutes; or +3 to a precise task after three rounds

guidelines.name: Corpchless (Body Feat)
guidelines.summary: Dex + Concentration: dislocate to escape shackles (6), slip a gap one Size smaller (9) or two (12); +3 to escape a grapple (6)

guidelines.name: Sáebchless Díberge (Wild Feat of Contortion)
guidelines.summary: Qui + Concentration: +3 Attack Advantage for trips and disarms, or +3 Defense against them

guidelines.name: Siaburchles (Phantom Feat)
guidelines.summary: Qui + Concentration: give no defence; a blow passes through harmlessly; never two rounds running

guidelines.name: Béim Co Commus (Stroke of Precision)
guidelines.summary: Dex + Single Weapon: harmless precision with a blade; Ease Factor the foe's Defense Total in a fight

guidelines.name: Brúd nGeme (Crushing Roar)
guidelines.summary: Sta + Single Weapon: after a hit, two damage levels to the foe's weapon; +1 Superior, +3 Excellent, +6 enchanted

guidelines.name: Fáenchless (Sloped Shield Feat)
guidelines.summary: Str + Single Weapon: with an edged shield (+2 damage), a winning parry deals a glancing blow, once a round

guidelines.name: Foramchles (Swooping Feat)
guidelines.summary: Sta + Single Weapon: Ease Factor 3 + the armour's Protection: one location's Protection loses a fifth, rounded up

guidelines.name: Cless Cletenach (Javelin Feat)
guidelines.summary: Dex + Thrown Weapon: two javelins: range increment 15, damage 2 x (Str + weapon) + Advantage

guidelines.name: Cless Nónbair (Nine-Men Feat)
guidelines.summary: Str + Thrown Weapon: up to nine javelins at one target; +1 Ease Factor each after the first

guidelines.name: Torannchless (Thunder Feat)
guidelines.summary: Str + Thrown Weapon: Ease Factor 6 + the foe's Brawl Defense: a sling stone to the head knocks him down, with thunder

guidelines.name: Ubullchless (Apple Feat)
guidelines.summary: Dex + Thrown Weapon: Ease Factor 3 + 2 a missile: juggle up to nine one-handed, load a sling unpaused or throw three a round

entries.guideline_source: The Contested Isle pp. 102-105: each cles's base Ease Factor (several change with the feat)

entries.name: Debterah
entries.description: Ethiopia's lay deacons of the Church and the Falasha, a holy societas who teach noble children, cast horoscopes, make protective amulets and drive out evil spirits with The Magic Star Book.
entries.notes: Lands of the Nile p. 114. A holy societas founded on Saint Yared's chants (his five books are a summa of Organization Lore: Ethiopian Church, Level 5, Quality 8); The societas has members in both the Christian and the Falasha Jewish communities, and Falasha kahens are often debterah before becoming rabbis: a member takes Theology: Christian or Theology: Judaism, whichever his faith. Their Holy Methods and Powers and Craft Amulets are Realms of Power: The Divine's (pp. 34-50, 137). Without that book, give one Clerk or Educated, Enchanting Music, and Sense Holiness and Unholiness or Wise One (with Wise One, some Divine and Infernal Lore); such a debtera has no exorcism of his own beyond leading ceremonies in a church's Divine aura, which its tabot and forest gather.

training.notes: No apprenticeship is printed: build the member as a normal character, buying the Methods and Powers as Supernatural Virtues (Realms of Power: The Divine), with Artes Liberales (astronomy), Chirurgy, Organization Lore: Ethiopian Church, Medicine, Music, Teaching and Theology (Christian or Judaism, by the member's faith).

casting.name: Holy Method and Power
casting.vis: none: holy effects use no vis
casting.notes: Realms of Power: The Divine: Characteristic + Method + Power + aura + a simple die against the level (Invocation costs a Confidence or Faith Point and may roll a stress die). A shortfall risks a tragedy of hubris.

casting.name: Minor amulet
casting.notes: Realms of Power: The Divine p. 137: max(1, 12 - Craft Amulets) hours; Dexterity + Craft Amulets + shape and material bonus + Dominion aura must reach twice the effect's level. One Individual; lasts days to weeks.

casting.name: Major amulet
casting.notes: Realms of Power: The Divine p. 137: Dexterity + Craft Amulets + Method + Power + shape and material bonus + Dominion aura; each consecutive season banks the total minus the level until the points reach the level. One a season.

activities.label: Make a major amulet
activities.summary: A season's work on a major amulet against evil spirits: bank the total minus its level until the points reach the level.

entries.name: House Merinita (Mystery Cult)
entries.description: The Mystery Cult of House Merinita: the Outer Mystery of Faerie Magic, then Inner Mysteries in three schools (Arcadian, Folk and Illusion) and the Founder's own Binding the Gift, learned through the House's lineages; the Nature Mysteries, from their own Outer Mystery, Nature Lore, lie outside them.
entries.notes: Every magus with Faerie Magic is a member: Initiating the Outer Mystery joins the House (Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p. 85). The Lore is House Merinita Lore; an Initiate should have it at 1 for an Inner Mystery, and Mystagogues usually have 4 or 5 (p. 88). Schools (p. 86): Arcadian (Arcadian Travel Minor; Animae Magic, Becoming Major), Folk (Charm Magic Minor; Story Magic, Symbolic Magic Major), Illusion (Spell Timing Minor; Glamour, Perpetuity Major), all on Faerie Magic; Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery); the Nature Mysteries (Awakening Minor; Wilding, Guardian of Nature Major), on Nature Lore. Glamour always brings Vulnerable Magic (p. 102); Perpetuity usually Unnatural Magic. Lineages and societies (pp. 82-106) each favour a school: the Line of Quendalon the Arcadian, the Heirs to Merlin the Folk, the Followers of Pendule and the Shadow-Masters the Illusion Mysteries, the Vestals and the True Merinitae the Nature Mysteries.

training.notes: Faerie Magic, the Outer Mystery, needs one touched by the fay; a Merinita parens gives an apprentice without a faerie Virtue or Flaw a Warping Point to qualify him (DE p. 236).

advancement.notes: Members advance as magi. Faerie Magic and House Merinita Lore are taught only to Initiates of the House's Mysteries (p. 88). Nature Lore grows only by Adventure, Practice and Exposure, its Source Quality the area's aura (p. 103).

initiation.notes: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults pp. 82-106; the Definitive Edition pp. 236-240 reprints Faerie Magic, the Illusion Mysteries' Followers of Pendule and Spell Timing, and wins where they differ. House Merinita Lore's specialties include Initiating oneself (p. 88). The sample Scripts use the usual Targets, lower after an Ordeal.

scripts.name: Line of Quendalon: Animae Magic
components: A season in a Faerie aura studying its inhabitants
Befriending the faerie fitted to her highest Technique and Form
Minor Ordeal: Faerie Friend
A bargain giving up a uniquely human quality
Minor Ordeal: a Prohibition against breaking her word
scripts.ordeal: Faerie Friend and a Prohibition (never break her word, or a faerie wasting sickness), two Minor Flaws
scripts.notes: A season studying a Faerie aura's inhabitants (+3); she befriends the faerie fitted to her highest Technique and Form (+1), taking Faerie Friend (+3), and seals it with a bargain giving up a human quality that can't be replaced (+6); a Prohibition never to break her word (+3) (p. 96). Quendalon's line may also Initiate Arcadian Travel, and its elders Initiate Becoming.

scripts.name: Heirs to Merlin: Charm Magic
components: A year apprenticed to a master of a charm Ability
A charm for a faerie noble of costly materials
The charm depicts a special symbolic quality of the patron
Quest: a unique object of myth or legend for the charm
scripts.notes: A year apprenticed to a master of a charm Ability (+1); a charm for a faerie noble of costly materials (+1) showing a symbolic quality of the patron (+3), tied to a unique object of legend she first finds (+3) (p. 100). The Heirs also Initiate Story Magic, and Symbolic Magic later in life.

scripts.name: Followers of Pendule: Spell Timing
components: A day and night awake, casting an Imaginem spell every round
Minor Ordeal: Harmless Magic
Minor Ordeal: Poor Memory (faces)
Minor Ordeal: Social Handicap
scripts.ordeal: Harmless Magic, Poor Memory (faces) and a Social Handicap, three Minor Flaws
scripts.notes: A day and a night without sleep, casting a non-fatiguing Imaginem spell every round to count the moments (+3), then three Minor Flaws (+3 each) (p. 102; DE p. 239). The Followers also Initiate Glamour, and Perpetuity as a dying master's last lesson.

scripts.name: Shadow-Masters: Glamour
components: Pursuing an illusion-wielding faerie until a Warping Point
-3 to Perception and Intelligence rolls until the Initiation ends
The anniversary of her Gift's manifestation
An Imaginem certamen with the Mystagogue to unconsciousness
Major Ordeal: Vulnerable Magic
scripts.notes: She pursues an illusion-skilled faerie until mischance gives her a Warping Point (+3), then is as if drunk, -3 to Perception and Intelligence rolls, until it ends (+1); on the date her Gift manifested (+1) she and the Mystagogue fight a Creo or Muto Imaginem certamen to unconsciousness, or she plays the Great Play (+1); she gains Vulnerable Magic (+9) (p. 83). Glamour always brings that Flaw (p. 102).

scripts.name: Vestals: Nature Lore (Lares Lore)
components: Wheat gathered on the three days of Lemuralia
Salt and sacred spring water prepared by the rites
The cake baked on Vestalia and set on her hearth
Her home cleansed on the Ides of June, the ashes in a river
Minor Ordeal: a Vow of chastity
The faeries covertly witness the oath
scripts.notes: A ritual cake: wheat from the days of Lemuralia (+1), salt cut from brine and spring water carried untouched to the ground (+1), baked on Vestalia and set on her hearth (+1); her home cleansed on the Ides of June (+1); before the Mystagogue she swears to honour the faeries and takes a Vow of chastity (+3), which the faeries witness (+3) (p. 85). Lares Lore is Nature Lore for household faeries.

scripts.name: True Merinitae: Wilding
components: Hosting a festival for Cybele, March 15th-27th
Ritual castration on the Day of Blood
Beneath a pine sacred to Cybele
A bowl filled with his blood
Major Ordeal: Short-Ranged Magic
His Wizard's Sigil turns toward violets
scripts.notes: A festival for Cybele (+1); on March 24th he is ritually castrated (+6) beneath a pine sacred to her (+1) and a bowl of his blood collected (+1); he gains Short-Ranged Magic (+9) and his Sigil turns toward violets (+1) (p. 106). Wilding needs Nature Lore.

entries.name: House Bjornaer (Mystery Cult)
entries.description: The Mystery Cult of House Bjornaer: the heartbeast awakened by the Ritual of Twelve Years, the House Mysteries Clan Ilfetu Initiates, the clans' own Mysteries, and the inner heartbeast a Great Beast ancestor teaches, refined afterwards by the magus alone.
entries.notes: Every magus with the Heartbeast is a member; no one leaves the House once Initiated (Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p. 18). One who has ever bound a familiar, an Initiate of another House's Mystery, or one known to change shape without a spell is refused (pp. 17-18). Temperaments (pp. 19-21): sanguine birds, choleric active land animals, melancholic slow or docile ones, phlegmatic all that crawl or swim; sanguine opposes melancholic, choleric phlegmatic. Clan Ilfetu Initiates the House Mysteries; a Clan Mystery's Mystagogue needs Presence + the Lore 8 (p. 25). The Inner Heartbeast needs the Lore 5 and a Great Beast (Presence +2, Lore 8) as Mystagogue (pp. 28-30).

training.notes: The Ritual of Twelve Years awakens the heartbeast, best at the Gathering of Twelve Years, by a Mystagogue of Clan Ilfetu: Heartbeast and the Ability at 1 (pp. 17, 25-26).

advancement.notes: Members advance as magi; House Bjornaer Lore is the cult's Lore (the Ability catalog's Mystery Cult Lore: Bjornaer).

initiation.notes: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults pp. 24-33; the Definitive Edition pp. 233-235 reprints the Heartbeast and Secret Name and wins where they differ. Only a Refinement is self-Initiated; the Great Beast stands in as the Inner Heartbeast's Mystagogue when none is named.

scripts.name: The Ritual of Twelve Years
components: A place and time resonant with the House's ancestors
The Initiate forever loses the ability to bind a familiar
scripts.ordeal: The ability to bind a familiar, forever (a Minor Ordeal for later Initiations, after character creation)
scripts.notes: At an ancestor site, best at the Gathering of Twelve Years; +1 for each witness (the Mystagogue included) sharing the probationer's temperament, -1 for each opposed, as the plan's other modifier. Never repeated: one who fails never enters the House (pp. 25-26).

scripts.name: Secret Name
components: On his birthday, a round tent set up on an ancestor site
A ritual cleansing ending at the hour of his birth
Minor Ordeal: a minor Weak Magic Resistance
scripts.ordeal: A minor version of Weak Magic Resistance (Minor Ordeal)
scripts.notes: Fails with a talisman or a familiar; any with Magic Resistance may take it (DE p. 235; HoH:MC pp. 26-27).

scripts.name: Theriomorphy
components: A year as his heartbeast, a mundane animal without magic or Parma
Minor Ordeal: Feral Scent or Disfigured (animal feature)
scripts.ordeal: Feral Scent or Disfigured (an animal feature) (Minor Ordeal)
scripts.notes: The year, then a ritual that taints the human form for ever (p. 27).

scripts.name: Sensory Magic
components: An ancestor site's deep pool no man has swum, at the dark of the moon
An item in his heartbeast's shape, enchanted with the five senses, cast into it
scripts.notes: A major sacrifice of time and vis (p. 28).

scripts.name: Clan Mystery: The Trial of (Name)
components: A special place at a special time
A rite of physical or mental mortification
Minor Ordeal
scripts.notes: Each clan's own Script, by an elder of the clan with Presence + the Lore 8 (p. 25).

scripts.name: Clan Mystery: The Trial of (Name), with a Major Ordeal
components: A special place at a special time
A rite of physical or mental mortification
Major Ordeal
scripts.notes: The Trial with a Major Ordeal in place of the Minor (p. 25).

scripts.name: Clan Mystery: The Deed of (Name)
components: A quest that will satisfy his ancestors, discovered
That quest completed
A season composing a poem, lay or song of the deed
scripts.notes: Each clan's own Script (p. 25).

scripts.name: Clan Mystery: The Oath of (Name)
components: A solemn oath pleasing the ancestors, as the Vow Flaw
A year demonstrating her dedication to it
The Mystagogue's season teaching the Virtue
scripts.notes: A minor breach loses the Virtue until amends are made; a major one loses it for ever (p. 25).

scripts.name: The Mystery of the Inner Heartbeast
components: Time spent discovering a suitable ancestor
Quest: the Great Beast's trials (10 Adventure experience)
Major Ordeal: a Hermetic or Supernatural Major Flaw
scripts.gains: The Mystery of the Epitome, the Chimera or the Anima (Major)
scripts.ordeal: A Hermetic or Supernatural Major Flaw of the Great Beast's choosing (Major Ordeal)
scripts.notes: The Initiate needs the Lore 5. A season as the Great Beast (Presence +2, the Lore 8, knowing the Mystery) tears apart and remakes his ancestral spirit; a known shapechanger's Ordeal must be the loss of his Skinchanger or Shapeshifter (pp. 17, 28-30).

scripts.name: Refinement: Changing Size
components: A season at an ancestor site
Vis eaten (a pawn per three points of the Ease Factor), a Warping Point
The Virtue used only in the inner heartbeast's form
scripts.gains: Changing Size for the inner heartbeast (Minor)
scripts.notes: The embryonic Script, self-Initiated: Muto vis eaten; +3 more for a Chimera; add a component (with the storyguide's -5 to +5 sympathy) when it falls short; +3 Ease Factor for each earlier increase (pp. 32-33).

scripts.name: Refinement: Increasing a Characteristic
components: A season at an ancestor site
Vis eaten (a pawn per three points of the Ease Factor), a Warping Point
The Virtue used only in the inner heartbeast's form
scripts.gains: Increasing a Characteristic for the inner heartbeast (Minor)
scripts.notes: The embryonic Script, self-Initiated: Creo vis eaten; +3 more for an Epitome; add a component (with the storyguide's -5 to +5 sympathy) when it falls short; +3 Ease Factor for each earlier increase of it (pp. 32-33).

scripts.name: Refinement: Acquiring a Quality
components: A season at an ancestor site
Vis eaten (a pawn per three points of the Ease Factor), a Warping Point
The Virtue used only in the inner heartbeast's form
scripts.gains: Acquiring a Quality for the inner heartbeast (Minor)
scripts.notes: The embryonic Script, self-Initiated: Animal vis eaten; +3 more for a Chimera; add a component (with the storyguide's -5 to +5 sympathy) when it falls short (pp. 32-33).

scripts.name: Refinement: Acquiring a Minor Virtue
components: A season at an ancestor site
Vis eaten (a pawn per three points of the Ease Factor), a Warping Point
The Virtue used only in the inner heartbeast's form
scripts.gains: Acquiring a Minor Virtue for the inner heartbeast (Minor)
scripts.notes: The embryonic Script, self-Initiated: Vim vis eaten; +3 more for an Epitome; add a component (with the storyguide's -5 to +5 sympathy) when it falls short (pp. 32-33).

scripts.name: Refinement: Acquiring a Major Virtue
components: A season at an ancestor site
Vis eaten (a pawn per three points of the Ease Factor), a Warping Point
The Virtue used only in the inner heartbeast's form
scripts.gains: Acquiring a Major Virtue for the inner heartbeast (Major)
scripts.notes: The embryonic Script, self-Initiated: Vim vis eaten; +3 more for an Epitome; add a component (with the storyguide's -5 to +5 sympathy) when it falls short (pp. 32-33).

scripts.name: Refinement: Acquiring a Minor Power
components: A season at an ancestor site
Vis eaten (a pawn per three points of the Ease Factor), a Warping Point
The Virtue used only in the inner heartbeast's form
scripts.gains: Acquiring a Minor Power for the inner heartbeast (Minor)
scripts.notes: The embryonic Script, self-Initiated: the Power's Form vis eaten; +3 more for an Anima; add a component (with the storyguide's -5 to +5 sympathy) when it falls short; the Lab Total in its Arts must exceed its level (pp. 32-33).

scripts.name: Refinement: Acquiring a Major Power
components: A season at an ancestor site
Vis eaten (a pawn per three points of the Ease Factor), a Warping Point
The Virtue used only in the inner heartbeast's form
scripts.gains: Acquiring a Major Power for the inner heartbeast (Major)
scripts.notes: The embryonic Script, self-Initiated: the Power's Form vis eaten; +3 more for an Anima; add a component (with the storyguide's -5 to +5 sympathy) when it falls short; the Lab Total in its Arts must exceed its level, and it is never constant (pp. 32-33).
